507 do k=1,nlev
508 do j=1,np
509 do i=1,np
510 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,np1) = xstate(lx)
511 lx = lx+1
512 end do
513 end do
514 end do
515 end do
516 do ie=nets,nete
517 do k=1,nlev
518 do j=1,np
519 do i=1,np
520 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,np1) = xstate(lx)
521 lx = lx+1
522 end do
523 end do
524 end do
525 end do
526 do ie=nets,nete
527 do k=1,nlev
528 do j=1,np
529 do i=1,np
530 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,np1) = xstate(lx)
531 lx = lx+1
532 end do
533 end do
534 end do
535 end do
536 do ie=nets,nete
537 do j=1,np
538 do i=1,np
539 elem(ie)%state%ps_v(i,j,np1) = xstate(lx)
540 lx = lx+1
541 end do
542 end do
543 end do
544#endif
545
546 else
54700 call abortmp('ERROR: bad choice of tstep_type')
548 endif
549
550! call prim_printstate(elem,tl,hybrid,hvcoord,nets,nete)
551
552 ! ==============================================
553 ! Time-split Horizontal diffusion: nu.del^2 or nu.del^4
554 ! U(*) = U(t+1) + dt2 * HYPER_DIFF_TERM(t+1)
555 ! ==============================================
556#ifdef ENERGY_DIAGNOSTICS
557 if (compute_diagnostics) then
558 do ie = nets,nete
559 elem(ie)%accum%DIFF(:,:,:,:)=elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,np1)
560 elem(ie)%accum%DIFFT(:,:,:)=elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,np1)
561 enddo
562 endif
563#endif
564
565 ! note:time step computes u(t+1)= u(t*) + RHS.
566 ! for consistency, dt_vis = t-1 - t*, so this is timestep method dependent
5677833678336 if (tstep_type==0) then
568 ! leapfrog special case
56900 call advance_hypervis_lf(edge3p1,elem,hvcoord,hybrid,deriv,nm1,n0,np1,nets,nete,dt_vis)
570 else
5717833678336 if (rsplit==0) then
572 ! forward-in-time, maybe hypervis applied to PS
57300 call advance_hypervis(edge3p1,elem,hvcoord,hybrid,deriv,np1,nets,nete,dt_vis,eta_ave_w)
574 else
575 ! forward-in-time, hypervis applied to dp3d
5767833678336 call advance_hypervis_dp(edge3p1,elem,hvcoord,hybrid,deriv,np1,nets,nete,dt_vis,eta_ave_w)
577 endif
578 endif
579
580#ifdef ENERGY_DIAGNOSTICS
581 if (compute_diagnostics) then
582 do ie = nets,nete
583#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
584!$omp parallel do private(k)
585#endif
586 do k=1,nlev ! Loop index added (AAM)
587 elem(ie)%accum%DIFF(:,:,:,k)=( elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,np1) -&
588 elem(ie)%accum%DIFF(:,:,:,k) ) / dt_vis
589 elem(ie)%accum%DIFFT(:,:,k)=( elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,np1) -&
590 elem(ie)%accum%DIFFT(:,:,k) ) / dt_vis
591 enddo
592 enddo
593 endif
594#endif
595
5967833678336 call t_stopf('prim_advance_exp')
5977833678336 call t_adj_detailf(-1)
5987833678336 end subroutine prim_advance_exp
599

601subroutine prim_advance_si(elem, nets, nete, cg, blkjac, red, &
602 refstate, hvcoord, deriv, flt, hybrid, tl, dt)
603 use bndry_mod, only : bndry_exchangev
604 use cg_mod, only : cg_t, cg_create
605 use control_mod, only : filter_freq,debug_level, precon_method
606 use derivative_mod, only : derivative_t, vorticity, divergence, gradient, gradient_wk
607 use dimensions_mod, only : np, nlev, nlevp
608 use edgetype_mod, only : EdgeBuffer_t
609 use edge_mod, only : edgevpack, edgevunpack, initEdgeBuffer
610 use element_mod, only : element_t
611 use filter_mod, only : filter_t, preq_filter
612 use hybvcoord_mod, only : hvcoord_t
613 use hybrid_mod, only : hybrid_t
614 use prim_si_ref_mod, only : ref_state_t, set_vert_struct_mat
615 use reduction_mod, only : reductionbuffer_ordered_1d_t
616 use solver_mod, only : pcg_solver, blkjac_t, blkjac_init
617 use time_mod, only : TimeLevel_t
618 use prim_si_mod, only : preq_vertadv, preq_omegap, preq_pressure
619 use diffusion_mod, only : prim_diffusion
620 use physical_constants, only : kappa, rrearth, rgas, cp, rwater_vapor
621 use physics_mod, only : virtual_temperature, virtual_specific_heat
622 implicit none
623
624 integer, intent(in) :: nets,nete
625 type (element_t), intent(inout), target :: elem(:)
626 type (blkjac_t), allocatable :: blkjac(:)
627
628 type (cg_t) :: cg
629
630 type (ReductionBuffer_ordered_1d_t), intent(inout) :: red
631
632 type (ref_state_t), intent(in), target :: refstate
633 type (hvcoord_t), intent(in) :: hvcoord
634 type (derivative_t), intent(in) :: deriv
635 type (filter_t), intent(in) :: flt
636 type (hybrid_t), intent(in) :: hybrid
637 type (TimeLevel_t), intent(in) :: tl
638 real(kind=real_kind), intent(in) :: dt
639 real(kind=real_kind) :: time_adv
640#ifndef _CRAYFTN
641 ! ==========================
642 ! Local variables...
643 ! ==========================
644
645 real(kind=real_kind) :: ps0
646 real(kind=real_kind) :: psref
647
648 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: ps
649 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: rps
650 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: rpmid
651 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: omegap
652 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: rpdel
653
654 real(kind=real_kind) :: pintref(nlevp)
655 real(kind=real_kind) :: pdelref(nlev)
656 real(kind=real_kind) :: pmidref(nlev)
657 real(kind=real_kind) :: rpdelref(nlev)
658 real(kind=real_kind) :: rpmidref(nlev)
659
660 real(kind=real_kind) :: pint(np,np,nlevp)
661 real(kind=real_kind) :: pdel(np,np,nlev)
662 real(kind=real_kind) :: pmid(np,np,nlev)
663
664 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlevp) :: eta_dot_dp_deta
665 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: vgrad_ps
666
667 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: T_vadv
668 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2,nlev) :: v_vadv
669
670 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: HT
671 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: HrefT
672 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: HrefTm1
673
674 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: Gref0
675 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: Grefm1
676 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: E
677 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: Phi
678 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: dGref
679
680 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2) :: vco
681 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2) :: gradT
682 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2) :: grad_Phi
683
684 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:), pointer :: Emat
685 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:), pointer :: Emat_inv
686 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:), pointer :: Amat
687 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:), pointer :: Amat_inv
688 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:), pointer :: Lambda
689
690 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:), pointer :: Tref
691 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:), pointer :: RTref
692 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:), pointer :: Pvec
693 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:), pointer :: Href
694 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:), pointer :: Tmat
695
696 real(kind=real_kind) :: Vscript(np,np,2,nlev,nets:nete)
697 real(kind=real_kind) :: Tscript(np,np,nlev,nets:nete)
698 real(kind=real_kind) :: Pscript(np,np,nets:nete)
699
700 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: HrefTscript
701 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: suml
702 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2) :: gVscript
703 real(kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: div_Vscript
704
705 real(kind=real_kind) :: B(np,np,nlev,nets:nete)
706 real(kind=real_kind) :: C(np,np,nlev,nets:nete)
707 real(kind=real_kind) :: D(np,np,nlev,nets:nete)
708
709 real(kind=real_kind) :: Gamma_ref(np,np,nlev,nets:nete)
710
711 real(kind=real_kind) :: Gref(np,np,nlev,nets:nete)
712 real(kind=real_kind) :: grad_dGref(np,np,2,nlev)
713 real(kind=real_kind) :: grad_Gref(np,np,2,nlev)
714
715 real(kind=real_kind) :: div(np,np)
716 real(kind=real_kind) :: gv(np,np,2)
717
718 real(kind=real_kind) :: dt2
719 real(kind=real_kind) :: rpsref
720 real(kind=real_kind) :: rdt
721 real(kind=real_kind) :: hkk, hkl
722 real(kind=real_kind) :: ddiv
723
724 real(kind=real_kind) :: vgradT
725 real(kind=real_kind) :: hybfac
726 real(kind=real_kind) :: Crkk
727 real(kind=real_kind) :: v1,v2
728 real(kind=real_kind) :: term
729
730 real(kind=real_kind) :: Vs1,Vs2
731 real(kind=real_kind) :: glnps1, glnps2
732 real(kind=real_kind) :: gGr1,gGr2
733
734 real (kind=real_kind),allocatable :: solver_wts(:,:) ! solver weights array for nonstaggered grid
735
736 integer :: nm1,n0,np1,nfilt
737 integer :: nstep
738 integer :: i,j,k,l,ie,kptr
739
740!JMD call t_barrierf('sync_prim_advance_si', hybrid%par%comm)
741 call t_adj_detailf(+1)
742 call t_startf('prim_advance_si')
743
744 nm1 = tl%nm1
745 n0 = tl%n0
746 np1 = tl%np1
747 nstep = tl%nstep
748
749
750 if ( dt /= initialized_for_dt ) then
751 if(hybrid%par%masterproc) print *,'Initializing semi-implicit matricies for dt=',dt
752
753#if (defined HORIZ_OPENMP)
754 !$OMP MASTER
755#endif
756 call set_vert_struct_mat(dt, refstate, hvcoord, hybrid%masterthread)
757#if (defined HORIZ_OPENMP)
758 !$OMP END MASTER
759#endif
760
761 allocate(solver_wts(np*np,nete-nets+1))
762 do ie=nets,nete
763 kptr=1
764 do j=1,np
765 do i=1,np
766
767 ! so this code is BFB with old code. should change to simpler formula below
768 solver_wts(kptr,ie-nets+1) = 1d0/nint(1d0/(elem(ie)%mp(i,j)*elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)))
769 !solver_wts(kptr,ie-nets+1) = elem(ie)%mp(i,j)*elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)
770
771 kptr=kptr+1
772 end do
773 end do
774 end do
775 call cg_create(cg, np*np, nlev, nete-nets+1, hybrid, debug_level, solver_wts)
776 deallocate(solver_wts)
777 if (precon_method == "block_jacobi") then
778 if (.not. allocated(blkjac)) then
779 allocate(blkjac(nets:nete))
780 endif
781 call blkjac_init(elem, deriv,refstate%Lambda,nets,nete,blkjac)
782 end if
783 initialized_for_dt = dt
784 endif
785
786
787 nfilt = tl%nm1 ! time level at which filter is applied (time level n)
788 dt2 = 2.0_real_kind*dt
789 rdt = 1.0_real_kind/dt
790
791 ps0 = hvcoord%ps0
792 psref = refstate%psr
793
794 Emat => refstate%Emat
795 Emat_inv => refstate%Emat_inv
796 Amat => refstate%Amat
797 Amat_inv => refstate%Amat_inv
798 Lambda => refstate%Lambda
799
800 RTref => refstate%RTref
801 Tref => refstate%Tref
802 Href => refstate%Href
803 Tmat => refstate%Tmat
804 Pvec => refstate%Pvec
805
806 ! ============================================================
807 ! If the time is right, apply a filter to the state variables
808 ! ============================================================
809
810 if (nstep > 0 .and. filter_freq > 0 .and. MODULO(nstep,filter_freq) == 0 ) then
811 call preq_filter(elem, edge3p1, flt, cg%hybrid, nfilt, nets, nete)
812 end if
813
814 do ie = nets, nete
815
816 ! elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(:,:,:) = gradient(elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,n0),deriv)*rrearth
817 call gradient(elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,n0),deriv,elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(:,:,:))
818 elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(:,:,:) = elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(:,:,:)*rrearth
819
820 end do
821
822 ! ================================================
823 ! boundary exchange grad_lnps
824 ! ================================================
825
826 do ie = nets, nete
827
828 do k=1,nlevp
829 pintref(k) = hvcoord%hyai(k)*ps0 + hvcoord%hybi(k)*psref
830 end do
831
832 do k=1,nlev
833 pmidref(k) = hvcoord%hyam(k)*ps0 + hvcoord%hybm(k)*psref
834 pdelref(k) = pintref(k+1) - pintref(k)
835 rpmidref(k) = 1.0_real_kind/pmidref(k)
836 rpdelref(k) = 1.0_real_kind/pdelref(k)
837 end do
838
839 rpsref = 1.0_real_kind/psref
840
841 ps(:,:) = EXP(elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,n0))
842 rps(:,:) = 1.0_real_kind/ps(:,:)
843
844 call preq_pressure(ps0,ps,hvcoord%hyai,hvcoord%hybi,hvcoord%hyam,hvcoord%hybm,pint,pmid,pdel)
845
846 rpmid = 1.0_real_kind/pmid
847 rpdel = 1.0_real_kind/pdel
848
849#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
850!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,v1,v2,vco)
851#endif
852 do k=1,nlev
853 do j=1,np
854 do i=1,np
855 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
856 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
857
858 ! Contravariant velocities
859
860 vco(i,j,1) = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,1)*v1 + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,2)*v2
861 vco(i,j,2) = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,1)*v1 + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,2)*v2
862
863 vgrad_ps(i,j,k) = ps(i,j)*(vco(i,j,1)*elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(i,j,1) + &
864 vco(i,j,2)*elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(i,j,2))
865
866 end do
867 end do
868 end do
869
870 call preq_omegap(elem(ie)%derived%div(:,:,:,n0),vgrad_ps,pdel,rpmid, &
871 hvcoord%hybm,hvcoord%hybd,elem(ie)%derived%omega_p)
872
873 Pscript(:,:,ie) = 0.0_real_kind
874 eta_dot_dp_deta(:,:,1) = 0.0_real_kind
875
876 do k=1,nlev
877 do j=1,np
878 do i=1,np
879 eta_dot_dp_deta(i,j,k+1) = eta_dot_dp_deta(i,j,k) + &
880 vgrad_ps(i,j,k)*hvcoord%hybd(k) + elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,k,n0)*pdel(i,j,k)
881 ddiv = elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,k,n0) - 0.5_real_kind*elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,k,nm1)
882 Pscript(i,j,ie) = Pscript(i,j,ie) + ddiv*pdelref(k)
883 end do
884 end do
885 end do
886
887 do j=1,np
888 do i=1,np
889 Pscript(i,j,ie) = elem(ie)%state%lnps(i,j,nm1) + &
890 dt2*( rpsref*Pscript(i,j,ie) - rps(i,j)*eta_dot_dp_deta(i,j,nlev+1) )
891 end do
892 end do
893
894#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
895!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
896#endif
897 do k=1,nlev-1
898 do j=1,np
899 do i=1,np
900 eta_dot_dp_deta(i,j,k+1) = hvcoord%hybi(k+1)*eta_dot_dp_deta(i,j,nlev+1) - &
901 eta_dot_dp_deta(i,j,k+1)
902 end do
903 end do
904 end do
905
906 eta_dot_dp_deta(:,:,nlev+1) = 0.0_real_kind
907
908 call preq_vertadv(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,n0),elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,n0), &
909 eta_dot_dp_deta,rpdel,T_vadv,v_vadv)
910
911 suml(:,:) = 0.0_real_kind
912
913 do k=1,nlev
914
915 ! gradT(:,:,:) = gradient(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,n0),deriv)*rrearth
916 call gradient(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,n0),deriv,gradT)
917 gradT=gradT*rrearth
918 Crkk = 0.5_real_kind
919
920 do j=1,np
921 do i=1,np
922 term = Crkk*(elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,k,n0) - &
923 0.5_real_kind*elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,k,nm1))*pdelref(k)
924 suml(i,j) = suml(i,j) + term
925
926 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
927 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
928
929 ! Contravariant velocities
930
931 vco(i,j,1) = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,1)*v1 + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,2)*v2
932 vco(i,j,2) = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,1)*v1 + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,2)*v2
933
934 vgradT = vco(i,j,1)*gradT(i,j,1) + vco(i,j,2)*gradT(i,j,2)
935
936 Tscript(i,j,k,ie) = elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nm1) &
937 + dt2*(- vgradT - T_vadv(i,j,k) &
938 + kappa*(elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)*elem(ie)%derived%omega_p(i,j,k) &
939 + Tref(k)*rpmidref(k)*suml(i,j)))
940 suml(i,j) = suml(i,j) + term
941 end do
942 end do
943 end do
944
945 HrefT(:,:) = 0.0_real_kind
946 HrefTm1(:,:) = 0.0_real_kind
947 HT(:,:) = 0.0_real_kind
948
949 do k=nlev,1,-1
950
951 do j=1,np
952 do i=1,np
953 hkl = rpmidref(k)*pdelref(k)
954 hkk = hkl*0.5_real_kind
955 Gref0(i,j) = HrefT(i,j) + Rgas*hkk*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)
956 HrefT(i,j) = HrefT(i,j) + Rgas*hkl*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)
957 Grefm1(i,j) = HrefTm1(i,j) + Rgas*hkk*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nm1)
958 HrefTm1(i,j) = HrefTm1(i,j) + Rgas*hkl*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nm1)
959 hkl = rpmid(i,j,k)*pdel(i,j,k)
960 hkk = hkl*0.5_real_kind
961 Phi(i,j) = HT(i,j) + Rgas*hkk*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)
962 HT(i,j) = HT(i,j) + Rgas*hkl*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)
963 end do
964 end do
965
966 do j=1,np
967 do i=1,np
968 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
969 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
970
971 ! covariant velocity
972
973 vco(i,j,1) = elem(ie)%D(i,j,1,1)*v1 + elem(ie)%D(i,j,2,1)*v2
974 vco(i,j,2) = elem(ie)%D(i,j,1,2)*v1 + elem(ie)%D(i,j,2,2)*v2
975
976 E(i,j) = 0.5_real_kind*( v1*v1 + v2*v2 )
977
978 Gref0(i,j) = Gref0(i,j) + elem(ie)%state%phis(i,j) + RTref(k)*elem(ie)%state%lnps(i,j,n0)
979 Grefm1(i,j) = Grefm1(i,j) + elem(ie)%state%phis(i,j) + RTref(k)*elem(ie)%state%lnps(i,j,nm1)
980
981 Phi(i,j) = Phi(i,j) + E(i,j) + elem(ie)%state%phis(i,j)
982 dGref(i,j) = -(Gref0(i,j) - 0.5_real_kind*Grefm1(i,j))
983 end do
984 end do
985
986 !elem(ie)%derived%zeta(:,:,k) = vorticity(vco,deriv)*rrearth
987 call vorticity(vco,deriv,elem(ie)%derived%zeta(:,:,k))
988 elem(ie)%derived%zeta(:,:,k) = elem(ie)%derived%zeta(:,:,k)*rrearth
989 !grad_Phi(:,:,:) = gradient(Phi,deriv)*rrearth
990 call gradient(Phi,deriv,grad_Phi(:,:,:))
991 grad_Phi(:,:,:) = grad_Phi(:,:,:)*rrearth
992 !grad_dGref(:,:,:,k) = gradient_wk(dGref,deriv)*rrearth
993 call gradient_wk(dGref,deriv,grad_dGref(:,:,:,k))
994 grad_dGref(:,:,:,k) = grad_dGref(:,:,:,k)*rrearth
995
996 do j=1,np
997 do i=1,np
998
999 elem(ie)%derived%zeta(i,j,k) = elem(ie)%rmetdet(i,j)*elem(ie)%derived%zeta(i,j,k)
1000 hybfac = hvcoord%hybm(k)*(ps(i,j)*rpmid(i,j,k))
1001
1002 glnps1 = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,1)*elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(i,j,1) + &
1003 elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,1)*elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(i,j,2)
1004 glnps2 = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,2)*elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(i,j,1) + &
1005 elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,2)*elem(ie)%derived%grad_lnps(i,j,2)
1006
1007 v1 = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,1)*grad_Phi(i,j,1) + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,1)*grad_Phi(i,j,2)
1008 v2 = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,2)*grad_Phi(i,j,1) + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,2)*grad_Phi(i,j,2)
1009
1010 Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie) = - v_vadv(i,j,1,k) &
1011 + elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0) * (elem(ie)%fcor(i,j) + elem(ie)%derived%zeta(i,j,k)) &
1012 - v1 - Rgas*hybfac*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)*glnps1
1013
1014 Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie) = - v_vadv(i,j,2,k) &
1015 - elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0) * (elem(ie)%fcor(i,j) + elem(ie)%derived%zeta(i,j,k)) &
1016 - v2 - Rgas*hybfac*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)*glnps2
1017
1018 end do
1019 end do
1020
1021 end do
1022
1023#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1024!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,Vs1,Vs2)
1025#endif
1026 do k=1,nlev
1027 do j=1,np
1028 do i=1,np
1029 Vs1 = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,1)*grad_dGref(i,j,1,k) + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,1)*grad_dGref(i,j,2,k)
1030 Vs2 = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,2)*grad_dGref(i,j,1,k) + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,2)*grad_dGref(i,j,2,k)
1031
1032 Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie) = elem(ie)%mp(i,j)*Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie) + Vs1
1033 Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie) = elem(ie)%mp(i,j)*Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie) + Vs2
1034
1035 Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie) = elem(ie)%mp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nm1) + dt2*Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie)
1036 Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie) = elem(ie)%mp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nm1) + dt2*Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie)
1037 end do
1038 end do
1039
1040 end do
1041
1042 HrefTscript(:,:) = 0.0_real_kind
1043
1044 do k=nlev,1,-1
1045
1046 do j=1,np
1047 do i=1,np
1048 hkl = rpmidref(k)*pdelref(k)
1049 hkk = hkl*0.5_real_kind
1050 B(i,j,k,ie) = HrefTscript(i,j) + Rgas*hkk*Tscript(i,j,k,ie)
1051 B(i,j,k,ie) = B(i,j,k,ie) + elem(ie)%state%phis(i,j) + RTref(k)*Pscript(i,j,ie)
1052 HrefTscript(i,j) = HrefTscript(i,j) + Rgas*hkl*Tscript(i,j,k,ie)
1053 end do
1054 end do
1055
1056 end do
1057
1058 kptr=0
1059 call edgeVpack(edge2, Vscript(1,1,1,1,ie),2*nlev,kptr,ie)
1060
1061 end do
1062
1063 call bndry_exchangeV(cg%hybrid,edge2)
1064
1065 do ie = nets, nete
1066
1067 kptr=0
1068 call edgeVunpack(edge2, Vscript(1,1,1,1,ie), 2*nlev, kptr, ie)
1069#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1070! Not sure about deriv here.
1071!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,gVscript,deriv)
1072#endif
1073 do k=1,nlev
1074 do j=1,np
1075 do i=1,np
1076 Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie) = elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)*Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie)
1077 Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie) = elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)*Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie)
1078 end do
1079 end do
1080
1081 do j=1,np
1082 do i=1,np
1083
1084 ! Contravariant Vscript
1085
1086 gVscript(i,j,1) = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,1)*Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie) + &
1087 elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,2)*Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie)
1088 gVscript(i,j,2) = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,1)*Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie) + &
1089 elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,2)*Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie)
1090
1091 gVscript(i,j,1) = elem(ie)%metdet(i,j)*gVscript(i,j,1)
1092 gVscript(i,j,2) = elem(ie)%metdet(i,j)*gVscript(i,j,2)
1093
1094 end do
1095 end do
1096
1097 ! div_Vscript(:,:,k) = divergence(gVscript,deriv)*rrearth
1098 call divergence(gVscript,deriv,div_Vscript(:,:,k))
1099 div_Vscript(:,:,k) = div_Vscript(:,:,k)*rrearth
1100
1101 end do
1102
1103#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1104!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,l)
1105#endif
1106 do k=1,nlev
1107
1108 do j=1,np
1109 do i=1,np
1110 C(i,j,k,ie) = elem(ie)%metdet(i,j)*B(i,j,k,ie)
1111 end do
1112 end do
1113
1114 do l=1,nlev
1115 do j=1,np
1116 do i=1,np
1117 C(i,j,k,ie) = C(i,j,k,ie) - dt*Amat(l,k)*div_Vscript(i,j,l)
1118 end do
1119 end do
1120 end do
1121
1122 end do
1123
1124 ! ===============================================================
1125 ! Weight C (the RHS of the helmholtz problem) by the mass matrix
1126 ! ===============================================================
1127
1128#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1129!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
1130#endif
1131 do k=1,nlev
1132 do j=1,np
1133 do i=1,np
1134 C(i,j,k,ie) = elem(ie)%mp(i,j)*C(i,j,k,ie)
1135 end do
1136 end do
1137 end do
1138
1139 ! ===================================
1140 ! Pack C into the edge1 buffer
1141 ! ===================================
1142
1143 kptr=0
1144 call edgeVpack(edge1,C(1,1,1,ie),nlev,kptr,ie)
1145
1146 end do
1147
1148 ! ==================================
1149 ! boundary exchange C
1150 ! ==================================
1151
1152 call bndry_exchangeV(cg%hybrid,edge1)
1153
1154 do ie=nets,nete
1155
1156 ! ===================================
1157 ! Unpack C from the edge1 buffer
1158 ! ===================================
1159
1160 kptr=0
1161 call edgeVunpack(edge1, C(1,1,1,ie), nlev, kptr, ie)
1162
1163 ! ===============================================
1164 ! Complete global assembly by normalizing by rmp
1165 ! ===============================================
1166
1167#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1168!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
1169#endif
1170 do k=1,nlev
1171
1172 do j=1,np
1173 do i=1,np
1174 D(i,j,k,ie) = elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)*C(i,j,k,ie)
1175 end do
1176 end do
1177
1178 end do
1179
1180#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1181!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,l)
1182#endif
1183 do k=1,nlev
1184
1185 do j=1,np
1186 do i=1,np
1187 C(i,j,k,ie) = 0.0_real_kind
1188 end do
1189 end do
1190
1191 do l=1,nlev
1192 do j=1,np
1193 do i=1,np
1194 C(i,j,k,ie) = C(i,j,k,ie) + Emat_inv(l,k)*D(i,j,l,ie)
1195 end do
1196 end do
1197 end do
1198
1199 end do
1200
1201 end do
1202 ! ==========================================
1203 ! solve for Gamma_ref, given C as RHS input
1204 ! ==========================================
1205
1206 Gamma_ref = pcg_solver(elem, &
1207 C, &
1208 cg, &
1209 red, &
1210 edge1, &
1211 edge2, &
1212 Lambda, &
1213 deriv, &
1214 nets, &
1215 nete, &
1216 blkjac)
1217
1218
1219 ! ================================================================
1220 ! Backsubstitute Gamma_ref into semi-implicit system of equations
1221 ! to find prognostic variables at time level n+1
1222 ! ================================================================
1223
1224 kptr=0
1225 do ie = nets, nete
1226
1227#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1228!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,l)
1229#endif
1230 do k=1,nlev
1231
1232 do j=1,np
1233 do i=1,np
1234 Gref(i,j,k,ie) = 0.0_real_kind
1235 end do
1236 end do
1237
1238 do l=1,nlev
1239 do j=1,np
1240 do i=1,np
1241 Gref(i,j,k,ie) = Gref(i,j,k,ie) + Emat(l,k)*Gamma_ref(i,j,l,ie)
1242 end do
1243 end do
1244 end do
1245
1246 do j=1,np
1247 do i=1,np
1248 B(i,j,k,ie) = elem(ie)%mp(i,j) * dt * (B(i,j,k,ie) - Gref(i,j,k,ie))
1249 end do
1250 end do
1251
1252 end do
1253
1254 call edgeVpack(edge1,B(:,:,:,ie),nlev,kptr,ie)
1255
1256 end do
1257
1258 call bndry_exchangeV(cg%hybrid,edge1)
1259
1260 do ie = nets, nete
1261
1262 kptr=0
1263 call edgeVunpack(edge1, B(:,:,:,ie), nlev, kptr, ie)
1264#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1265!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
1266#endif
1267 do k=1,nlev
1268
1269 do j=1,np
1270 do i=1,np
1271 B(i,j,k,ie) = elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)*B(i,j,k,ie)
1272 end do
1273 end do
1274
1275 end do
1276
1277#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1278!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,l)
1279#endif
1280 do k=1,nlev
1281
1282 do j=1,np
1283 do i=1,np
1284 D(i,j,k,ie) = 0.0_real_kind
1285 end do
1286 end do
1287
1288 do l=1,nlev
1289 do j=1,np
1290 do i=1,np
1291 D(i,j,k,ie) = D(i,j,k,ie) + Emat_inv(l,k)*B(i,j,l,ie)
1292 end do
1293 end do
1294 end do
1295
1296 end do
1297
1298#if 1
1299#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1300!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,l)
1301#endif
1302 do k=1,nlev
1303
1304 do j=1,np
1305 do i=1,np
1306 elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,k,np1) = 0.0_real_kind
1307 end do
1308 end do
1309
1310 do l=1,nlev
1311 do j=1,np
1312 do i=1,np
1313 elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,k,np1) = elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,k,np1) + Emat(l,k)*D(i,j,l,ie)/Lambda(l)
1314 end do
1315 end do
1316 end do
1317
1318 end do
1319#endif
1320
1321 do k=1,nlev
1322
1323 ! grad_Gref(:,:,:,k)=gradient_wk(Gref(:,:,k,ie),deriv)*rrearth
1324 call gradient_wk(Gref(:,:,k,ie),deriv,grad_Gref(:,:,:,k))
1325 grad_Gref(:,:,:,k)=grad_Gref(:,:,:,k)*rrearth
1326
1327 do j=1,np
1328 do i=1,np
1329 gGr1 = grad_Gref(i,j,1,k)
1330 gGr2 = grad_Gref(i,j,2,k)
1331 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,np1) = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,1)*gGr1 + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,1)*gGr2
1332 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,np1) = elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,1,2)*gGr1 + elem(ie)%Dinv(i,j,2,2)*gGr2
1333 end do
1334 end do
1335
1336 do j=1,np
1337 do i=1,np
1338 Pscript(i,j,ie) = Pscript(i,j,ie) - dt*Pvec(k)*elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,k,np1)
1339 end do
1340 end do
1341
1342
1343 do l=1,nlev
1344 do j=1,np
1345 do i=1,np
1346 Tscript(i,j,k,ie) = Tscript(i,j,k,ie) - dt*Tmat(l,k)*elem(ie)%derived%div(i,j,l,np1)
1347 end do
1348 end do
1349 end do
1350
1351 end do
1352
1353 do j=1,np
1354 do i=1,np
1355 Pscript(i,j,ie) = elem(ie)%mp(i,j)*Pscript(i,j,ie)
1356 end do
1357 end do
1358 do k=1,nlev
1359 do j=1,np
1360 do i=1,np
1361 Tscript(i,j,k,ie) = elem(ie)%mp(i,j)*Tscript(i,j,k,ie)
1362 end do
1363 end do
1364 end do
1365
1366 ! ===============================================
1367 ! Pack v at time level n+1 into the edge3p1 buffer
1368 ! ===============================================
1369
1370 kptr=0
1371 call edgeVpack(edge3p1, elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,np1),2*nlev,kptr,ie)
1372
1373 kptr=2*nlev
1374 call edgeVpack(edge3p1, Tscript(:,:,:,ie),nlev,kptr,ie)
1375
1376 kptr=3*nlev
1377 call edgeVpack(edge3p1, Pscript(:,:,ie),1,kptr,ie)
1378
1379 end do
1380
1381 ! ======================================
1382 ! boundary exchange v at time level n+1
1383 ! ======================================
1384
1385 call bndry_exchangeV(cg%hybrid,edge3p1)
1386
1387 do ie=nets,nete
1388
1389 ! ===================================
1390 ! Unpack v from the edge2 buffer
1391 ! ===================================
1392
1393 kptr=0
1394 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,np1), 2*nlev, kptr, ie)
1395
1396 kptr=2*nlev
1397 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, Tscript(:,:,:,ie), nlev, kptr, ie)
1398
1399 kptr=3*nlev
1400 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, Pscript(:,:,ie), 1, kptr, ie)
1401
1402 ! ==========================================================
1403 ! Complete global assembly by normalizing velocity by rmp
1404 ! Vscript = Vscript - dt*grad(Gref)
1405 ! ==========================================================
1406
1407#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1408!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
1409#endif
1410 do k=1,nlev
1411
1412 do j=1,np
1413 do i=1,np
1414 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,np1) = Vscript(i,j,1,k,ie) + dt*elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,np1)
1415 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,np1) = Vscript(i,j,2,k,ie) + dt*elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,np1)
1416 end do
1417 end do
1418
1419 end do
1420
1421 do j=1,np
1422 do i=1,np
1423 elem(ie)%state%lnps(i,j,np1) = elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)*Pscript(i,j,ie)
1424 end do
1425 end do
1426
1427#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1428!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
1429#endif
1430 do k=1,nlev
1431 do j=1,np
1432 do i=1,np
1433 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,np1) = elem(ie)%rmp(i,j)*Tscript(i,j,k,ie)
1434 end do
1435 end do
1436 end do
1437
1438 end do
1439#if 1
1440 call prim_diffusion(elem, nets,nete,np1,deriv,dt2,cg%hybrid)
1441#endif
1442 call t_stopf('prim_advance_si')
1443 call t_adj_detailf(-1)
1444#endif
1445 end subroutine prim_advance_si
1446
1447
1448 subroutine preq_robert3(nm1,n0,np1,elem,hvcoord,nets,nete)
1449 use dimensions_mod, only : np, nlev, qsize
1450 use hybvcoord_mod, only : hvcoord_t
1451 use element_mod, only : element_t
1452 use time_mod, only: smooth
1453 use control_mod, only : integration
1454
1455 implicit none
1456 integer , intent(in) :: nm1,n0,np1,nets,nete
1457 type (hvcoord_t), intent(in) :: hvcoord
1458 type (element_t) , intent(inout) :: elem(:)
1459
1460
1461 integer :: i,j,k,ie,q
1462 real (kind=real_kind) :: dp
1463 logical :: filter_ps = .false.
1464 if (integration == "explicit") filter_ps = .true.
1465
1466 call t_adj_detailf(+1)
1467 call t_startf('preq_robert')
1468 do ie=nets,nete
1469 if (filter_ps) then
1470 elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0) = elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0) + smooth*(elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nm1) &
1471 - 2.0D0*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0) + elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1))
1472 elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,n0) = LOG(elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0))
1473 else
1474 elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,n0) = elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,n0) + smooth*(elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,nm1) &
1475 - 2.0D0*elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,n0) + elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,np1))
1476 elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0) = EXP(elem(ie)%state%lnps(:,:,n0))
1477 endif
1478
1479 elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,n0) = elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,n0) + smooth*(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,nm1) &
1480 - 2.0D0*elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,n0) + elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,np1))
1481 elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,n0) = elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,n0) + smooth*(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,nm1) &
1482 - 2.0D0*elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,n0) + elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,np1))
1483
1484 end do
1485 call t_stopf('preq_robert')
1486 call t_adj_detailf(-1)
1487
1488 end subroutine preq_robert3
1489
1490
1491
1492
1493 subroutine applyCAMforcing(elem,fvm,hvcoord,np1,np1_qdp,dt_q,nets,nete)
1494 use dimensions_mod, only : np, nc, nlev, qsize, ntrac
1495 use element_mod, only : element_t
1496 use hybvcoord_mod, only : hvcoord_t
1497 use control_mod, only : moisture, tracer_grid_type
1498 use control_mod, only : TRACER_GRIDTYPE_GLL, TRACER_GRIDTYPE_FVM
1499 use physical_constants, only: Cp
1500 use fvm_control_volume_mod, only : fvm_struct
1501 implicit none
1502 type (element_t) , intent(inout) :: elem(:)
1503 type(fvm_struct) , intent(inout) :: fvm(:)
1504 real (kind=real_kind), intent(in) :: dt_q
1505 type (hvcoord_t), intent(in) :: hvcoord
1506 integer, intent(in) :: np1,nets,nete,np1_qdp
1507
1508 ! local
1509 integer :: i,j,k,ie,q
1510 real (kind=real_kind) :: v1,dp
1511 real (kind=real_kind) :: beta(np,np),E0(np,np),ED(np,np),dp0m1(np,np),dpsum(np,np)
1512 logical :: wet
1513
1514 wet = (moisture /= "dry")
1515
1516 do ie=nets,nete
1517 ! apply forcing to Qdp
1518 elem(ie)%derived%FQps(:,:,1)=0
1519#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1520!$omp parallel do private(q,k,i,j,v1)
1521#endif
1522 if (tracer_grid_type == TRACER_GRIDTYPE_GLL) then
1523 do q=1,qsize
1524 do k=1,nlev
1525 do j=1,np
1526 do i=1,np
1527 v1 = dt_q*elem(ie)%derived%FQ(i,j,k,q,1)
1528 !if (elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1) + v1 < 0 .and. v1<0) then
1529 if (elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp) + v1 < 0 .and. v1<0) then
1530 !if (elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1) < 0 ) then
1531 if (elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp) < 0 ) then
1532 v1=0 ! Q already negative, dont make it more so
1533 else
1534 !v1 = -elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1)
1535 v1 = -elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp)
1536 endif
1537 endif
1538 !elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1) = elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1)+v1
1539 elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp) = elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp)+v1
1540 if (q==1) then
1541 elem(ie)%derived%FQps(i,j,1)=elem(ie)%derived%FQps(i,j,1)+v1/dt_q
1542 endif
1543 enddo
1544 enddo
1545 enddo
1546 enddo
1547 else if (tracer_grid_type == TRACER_GRIDTYPE_FVM) then
1548 ! Repeat for the fvm tracers
1549 do q = 1, ntrac
1550 do k = 1, nlev
1551 do j = 1, nc
1552 do i = 1, nc
1553 v1 = fvm(ie)%fc(i,j,k,q)
1554 if (fvm(ie)%c(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp) + v1 < 0 .and. v1<0) then
1555 if (fvm(ie)%c(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp) < 0 ) then
1556 v1 = 0 ! C already negative, dont make it more so
1557 else
1558 v1 = -fvm(ie)%c(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp)
1559 end if
1560 end if
1561 fvm(ie)%c(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp) = fvm(ie)%c(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp) + v1
1562! if (q == 1) then
1563!!XXgoldyXX: Should update the pressure forcing here??!!??
1564! elem(ie)%derived%FQps(i,j,1)=elem(ie)%derived%FQps(i,j,1)+v1/dt_q
1565! end if
1566 end do
1567 end do
1568 end do
1569 end do
1570 else
1571 call abortmp('applyCAMforcing: ERROR: unsupported value for tracer_grid_type')
1572 end if
1573
1574 if (wet .and. qsize>0) then
1575 ! to conserve dry mass in the precese of Q1 forcing:
1576 elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1) = elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1) + &
1577 dt_q*elem(ie)%derived%FQps(:,:,1)
1578 endif
1579
1580#if 0
1581 ! disabled - energy fixers will be moving into CAM physics
1582 ! energy fixer for FQps term
1583 ! dp1 = dp0 + d(FQps)
1584 ! dp0-dp1 = -d(FQps)
1585 ! E0-E1 = sum( dp0*ED) - sum( dp1*ED) = sum( dp0-dp1) * ED )
1586 ! compute E0-E1
1587 E0=0
1588 do k=1,nlev
1589 ED(:,:) = ( 0.5d0* &
1590 (elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,1,k,np1)**2 + elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,2,k,np1)**2)&
1591 + cp*elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,np1) &
1592 + elem(ie)%state%phis(:,:) )
1593
1594 dp0m1(:,:) = -dt_q*( hvcoord%hybi(k+1) - hvcoord%hybi(k) )*elem(ie)%derived%FQps(:,:,1)
1595
1596 E0(:,:) = E0(:,:) + dp0m1(:,:)*ED(:,:)
1597 enddo
1598 ! energy fixer:
1599 ! Tnew = T + beta
1600 ! cp*dp*beta = E0-E1 beta = (E0-E1)/(cp*sum(dp))
1601
1602 dpsum(:,:) = ( hvcoord%hyai(nlev+1) - hvcoord%hyai(1) )*hvcoord%ps0 + &
1603 ( hvcoord%hybi(nlev+1) - hvcoord%hybi(1) )*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1)
1604
1605 beta(:,:)=E0(:,:)/(dpsum(:,:)*cp)
1606 do k=1,nlev
1607 elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,np1)=elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,np1)+beta(:,:)
1608 enddo
1609#endif
1610
1611
1612
1613
1614 ! Qdp(np1) and ps_v(np1) were updated by forcing - update Q(np1)
1615#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1616!$omp parallel do private(q,k,i,j,dp)
1617#endif
1618 do q=1,qsize
1619 do k=1,nlev
1620 do j=1,np
1621 do i=1,np
1622 dp = ( hvcoord%hyai(k+1) - hvcoord%hyai(k) )*hvcoord%ps0 + &
1623 ( hvcoord%hybi(k+1) - hvcoord%hybi(k) )*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(i,j,np1)
1624 elem(ie)%state%Q(i,j,k,q) = elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,q,np1_qdp)/dp
1625 enddo
1626 enddo
1627 enddo
1628 enddo
1629
1630 elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,np1) = elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,np1) + &
1631 dt_q*elem(ie)%derived%FT(:,:,:,1)
1632 elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,np1) = elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,np1) + &
1633 dt_q*elem(ie)%derived%FM(:,:,:,:,1)
1634 enddo
1635 end subroutine applyCAMforcing
1636

1643

1665 subroutine advance_hypervis(edge3,elem,hvcoord,hybrid,deriv,nt,nets,nete,dt2,eta_ave_w)
1666 !
1667 ! take one timestep of:
1668 ! u(:,:,:,np) = u(:,:,:,np) + dt2*nu*laplacian**order ( u )
1669 ! T(:,:,:,np) = T(:,:,:,np) + dt2*nu_s*laplacian**order ( T )
1670 !
1671 !
1672 ! For correct scaling, dt2 should be the same 'dt2' used in the leapfrog advace
1673 !
1674 !
1675 use dimensions_mod, only : np, np, nlev
1676 use control_mod, only : nu, nu_div, nu_s, hypervis_order, hypervis_subcycle, nu_p, nu_top, psurf_vis
1677 use hybrid_mod, only : hybrid_t
1678 use hybvcoord_mod, only : hvcoord_t
1679 use element_mod, only : element_t
1680 use derivative_mod, only : derivative_t, laplace_sphere_wk, vlaplace_sphere_wk
1681 use edgetype_mod, only : EdgeBuffer_t
1682 use edge_mod, only : edgevpack, edgevunpack
1683 use bndry_mod, only : bndry_exchangev
1684 use viscosity_mod, only : biharmonic_wk
1685 use physical_constants, only: Cp
1686! use time_mod, only : TimeLevel_t
1687 implicit none
1688
1689 type (hybrid_t) , intent(in) :: hybrid
1690 type (element_t) , intent(inout), target :: elem(:)
1691 type (EdgeBuffer_t) , intent(inout) :: edge3
1692 type (derivative_t) , intent(in) :: deriv
1693 type (hvcoord_t), intent(in) :: hvcoord
1694! type (TimeLevel_t) , intent(in) :: tl
1695
1696 real (kind=real_kind) :: dt2
1697 integer :: nets,nete
1698
1699 ! local
1700 real (kind=real_kind) :: eta_ave_w ! weighting for mean flux terms
1701 real (kind=real_kind) :: nu_scale, dpdn,dpdn0, nu_scale_top
1702 integer :: k,kptr,i,j,ie,ic,nt
1703 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2,nlev,nets:nete) :: vtens
1704 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev,nets:nete) :: ptens
1705 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nets:nete) :: pstens
1706 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: p
1707 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: dptemp1,dptemp2
1708
1709
1710! NOTE: PGI compiler bug: when using spheremp, rspheremp and ps as pointers to elem(ie)% members,
1711 ! data is incorrect (offset by a few numbers actually)
1712 ! removed for now.
1713 ! real (kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:), pointer :: spheremp,rspheremp
1714 ! real (kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:,:), pointer :: ps
1715
1716 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: lap_p
1717 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2) :: lap_v
1718 real (kind=real_kind) :: v1,v2,dt,heating,utens_tmp,vtens_tmp,ptens_tmp
1719
1720
1721 if (nu_s == 0 .and. nu == 0 .and. nu_p==0 ) return;
1722!JMD call t_barrierf('sync_advance_hypervis', hybrid%par%comm)
1723 call t_adj_detailf(+1)
1724 call t_startf('advance_hypervis')
1725
1726
1727 dt=dt2/hypervis_subcycle
1728!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
1729 ! regular viscosity
1730!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
1731 if (hypervis_order == 1) then
1732 if (nu_p>0) call abortmp( 'ERROR: hypervis_order == 1 not coded for nu_p>0')
1733 do ic=1,hypervis_subcycle
1734 do ie=nets,nete
1735
1736#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1737! Not sure about deriv here
1738!$omp parallel do private(k,lap_p,lap_v,deriv,i,j)
1739#endif
1740 do k=1,nlev
1741 ! lap_p=laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
1742 call laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_p,var_coef=.false.)
1743 ! lap_v=vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
1744 call vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_v,var_coef=.false.)
1745 ! advance in time. (note: DSS commutes with time stepping, so we
1746 ! can time advance and then DSS. this has the advantage of
1747 ! not letting any discontinuties accumulate in p,v via roundoff
1748 do j=1,np
1749 do i=1,np
1750 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)*elem(ie)%spheremp(i,j) + dt*nu_s*lap_p(i,j)
1751 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)*elem(ie)%spheremp(i,j) + dt*nu*lap_v(i,j,1)
1752 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)*elem(ie)%spheremp(i,j) + dt*nu*lap_v(i,j,2)
1753 enddo
1754 enddo
1755 enddo
1756
1757 kptr=0
1758 call edgeVpack(edge3, elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,nt),nlev,kptr,ie)
1759 kptr=nlev
1760 call edgeVpack(edge3,elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,nt),2*nlev,kptr,ie)
1761 enddo
1762
1763 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3)
1764
1765 do ie=nets,nete
1766
1767 kptr=0
1768 call edgeVunpack(edge3, elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,nt), nlev, kptr, ie)
1769 kptr=nlev
1770 call edgeVunpack(edge3, elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,nt), 2*nlev, kptr, ie)
1771
1772 ! apply inverse mass matrix
1773#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1774!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
1775#endif
1776 do k=1,nlev
1777 do j=1,np
1778 do i=1,np
1779 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)
1780 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)=elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)
1781 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)=elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)
1782 enddo
1783 enddo
1784 enddo
1785 enddo
1786 enddo ! subcycle
1787 endif
1788
1789
1790!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
1791 ! hyper viscosity
1792!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
1793! nu_p=0:
1794! scale T dissipaton by dp (conserve IE, dissipate T^2)
1795! nu_p>0
1796! dont scale: T equation IE dissipation matches (to truncation error)
1797! IE dissipation from continuity equation
1798! (1 deg: to about 0.1 W/m^2)
1799!
1800 if (hypervis_order == 2) then
1801 do ic=1,hypervis_subcycle
1802 call biharmonic_wk(elem,pstens,ptens,vtens,deriv,edge3,hybrid,nt,nets,nete)
1803 do ie=nets,nete
1804
1805 ! comptue mean flux
1806 if (nu_p>0) then
1807#if 0
1808 elem(ie)%derived%psdiss_ave(:,:)=&
1809 elem(ie)%derived%psdiss_ave(:,:)+eta_ave_w*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nt)/hypervis_subcycle
1810 elem(ie)%derived%psdiss_biharmonic(:,:)=&
1811 elem(ie)%derived%psdiss_biharmonic(:,:)+eta_ave_w*pstens(:,:,ie)/hypervis_subcycle
1812#else
1813 do k=1,nlev
1814 dptemp1(:,:) = ( hvcoord%hyai(k+1) - hvcoord%hyai(k) )*hvcoord%ps0 + &
1815 ( hvcoord%hybi(k+1) - hvcoord%hybi(k) )*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nt)
1816 elem(ie)%derived%dpdiss_ave(:,:,k)=elem(ie)%derived%dpdiss_ave(:,:,k)+eta_ave_w*dptemp1(:,:)/hypervis_subcycle
1817
1818 dptemp2(:,:) = (hvcoord%hybi(k+1)-hvcoord%hybi(k))*pstens(:,:,ie)
1819 elem(ie)%derived%dpdiss_biharmonic(:,:,k)=&
1820 elem(ie)%derived%dpdiss_biharmonic(:,:,k)+eta_ave_w*dptemp2(:,:)/hypervis_subcycle
1821 enddo
1822#endif
1823 endif
1824 nu_scale=1
1825#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1826!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,lap_p,lap_v,nu_scale_top,dpdn,dpdn0,nu_scale,utens_tmp,vtens_tmp,ptens_tmp)
1827#endif
1828 do k=1,nlev
1829 ! advace in time.
1830 ! note: DSS commutes with time stepping, so we can time advance and then DSS.
1831 ! note: weak operators alreayd have mass matrix "included"
1832
1833 ! add regular diffusion in top 3 layers:
1834 if (nu_top>0 .and. k<=3) then
1835 ! lap_p=laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
1836 call laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_p,var_coef=.false.)
1837 !lap_v=vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
1838 call vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_v,var_coef=.false.)
1839 endif
1840 nu_scale_top = 1
1841 if (k==1) nu_scale_top=4
1842 if (k==2) nu_scale_top=2
1843
1844 do j=1,np
1845 do i=1,np
1846 if (nu_p==0) then
1847 ! normalize so as to conserve IE
1848 ! scale by 1/rho (normalized to be O(1))
1849 ! dp/dn = O(ps0)*O(delta_eta) = O(ps0)/O(nlev)
1850 dpdn = ( hvcoord%hyai(k+1) - hvcoord%hyai(k) )*hvcoord%ps0 + &
1851 ( hvcoord%hybi(k+1) - hvcoord%hybi(k) )*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(i,j,nt)
1852 dpdn0 = ( hvcoord%hyai(k+1) - hvcoord%hyai(k) )*hvcoord%ps0 + &
1853 ( hvcoord%hybi(k+1) - hvcoord%hybi(k) )*hvcoord%ps0
1854 nu_scale = dpdn0/dpdn
1855 endif
1856
1857 ! biharmonic terms need a negative sign:
1858 if (nu_top>0 .and. k<=3) then
1859 utens_tmp=(-nu*vtens(i,j,1,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_v(i,j,1))
1860 vtens_tmp=(-nu*vtens(i,j,2,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_v(i,j,2))
1861 ptens_tmp=nu_scale*(-nu_s*ptens(i,j,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_p(i,j) )
1862 else
1863 utens_tmp=-nu*vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)
1864 vtens_tmp=-nu*vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)
1865 ptens_tmp=-nu_scale*nu_s*ptens(i,j,k,ie)
1866 endif
1867
1868 ptens(i,j,k,ie) = ptens_tmp
1869 vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)=utens_tmp
1870 vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)=vtens_tmp
1871 enddo
1872 enddo
1873 enddo
1874
1875 pstens(:,:,ie) = -nu_p*pstens(:,:,ie)
1876 kptr=0
1877 call edgeVpack(edge3, ptens(:,:,:,ie),nlev,kptr, ie)
1878 kptr=nlev
1879 call edgeVpack(edge3,vtens(:,:,:,:,ie),2*nlev,kptr,ie)
1880 kptr=3*nlev
1881 call edgeVpack(edge3,pstens(:,:,ie),1,kptr,ie)
1882 enddo
1883
1884
1885 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3)
1886
1887 do ie=nets,nete
1888
1889 kptr=0
1890 call edgeVunpack(edge3, ptens(:,:,:,ie), nlev, kptr, ie)
1891 kptr=nlev
1892 call edgeVunpack(edge3, vtens(:,:,:,:,ie), 2*nlev, kptr, ie)
1893
1894
1895 ! apply inverse mass matrix, accumulate tendencies
1896#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
1897!$omp parallel do private(k)
1898#endif
1899 do k=1,nlev
1900 vtens(:,:,1,k,ie)=dt*vtens(:,:,1,k,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
1901 vtens(:,:,2,k,ie)=dt*vtens(:,:,2,k,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
1902 ptens(:,:,k,ie)=dt*ptens(:,:,k,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
1903 enddo
1904
1905 ! apply hypervis to u -> u+utens:
1906 ! E0 = dpdn * .5*u dot u + dpdn * T + dpdn*PHIS
1907 ! E1 = dpdn * .5*(u+utens) dot (u+utens) + dpdn * (T-X) + dpdn*PHIS
1908 ! E1-E0: dpdn (u dot utens) + dpdn .5 utens dot utens - dpdn X
1909 ! X = (u dot utens) + .5 utens dot utens
1910 ! alt: (u+utens) dot utens
1911 do k=1,nlev
1912 do j=1,np
1913 do i=1,np
1914 ! update v first (gives better results than updating v after heating)
1915 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,:,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,:,k,nt) + &
1916 vtens(i,j,:,k,ie)
1917
1918 v1=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)
1919 v2=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)
1920 heating = (vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)*v1 + vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)*v2 )
1921 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt) &
1922 +ptens(i,j,k,ie)-heating/cp
1923
1924 enddo
1925 enddo
1926 enddo
1927
1928 if (nu_p>0) then
1929 kptr=3*nlev
1930 call edgeVunpack(edge3, pstens(:,:,ie), 1, kptr, ie)
1931 pstens(:,:,ie)=dt*pstens(:,:,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
1932 elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nt)=elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nt) + pstens(:,:,ie)
1933 endif
1934
1935 enddo
1936 enddo
1937 endif
1938
1939 call t_stopf('advance_hypervis')
1940 call t_adj_detailf(-1)
1941
1942 end subroutine advance_hypervis
1943
1944
1945
1946
194778336156672 subroutine advance_hypervis_dp(edge3,elem,hvcoord,hybrid,deriv,nt,nets,nete,dt2,eta_ave_w)
1948 !
1949 ! take one timestep of:
1950 ! u(:,:,:,np) = u(:,:,:,np) + dt2*nu*laplacian**order ( u )
1951 ! T(:,:,:,np) = T(:,:,:,np) + dt2*nu_s*laplacian**order ( T )
1952 !
1953 !
1954 ! For correct scaling, dt2 should be the same 'dt2' used in the leapfrog advace
1955 !
1956 !
1957 use dimensions_mod, only : np, np, nlev
1958 use control_mod, only : nu, nu_div, nu_s, hypervis_order, hypervis_subcycle, nu_p, nu_top, psurf_vis
1959 use hybrid_mod, only : hybrid_t
1960 use hybvcoord_mod, only : hvcoord_t
1961 use element_mod, only : element_t
1962 use derivative_mod, only : derivative_t, laplace_sphere_wk, vlaplace_sphere_wk
1963 use edgetype_mod, only : EdgeBuffer_t
1964 use edge_mod, only : edgevpack, edgevunpack
1965 use bndry_mod, only : bndry_exchangev
1966 use viscosity_mod, only : biharmonic_wk_dp3d
1967 use physical_constants, only: Cp
1968! use time_mod, only : TimeLevel_t
1969 implicit none
1970
1971 type (hybrid_t) , intent(in) :: hybrid
1972 type (element_t) , intent(inout), target :: elem(:)
1973 type (EdgeBuffer_t) , intent(inout) :: edge3
1974 type (derivative_t) , intent(in) :: deriv
1975 type (hvcoord_t), intent(in) :: hvcoord
1976! type (TimeLevel_t) , intent(in) :: tl
1977
1978 real (kind=real_kind) :: dt2
1979 integer :: nets,nete
1980
1981 ! local
1982 real (kind=real_kind) :: eta_ave_w ! weighting for mean flux terms
1983 real (kind=real_kind) :: dpdn,dpdn0, nu_scale_top
1984 integer :: k,kptr,i,j,ie,ic,nt
1985 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2,nlev,nets:nete) :: vtens
1986 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev,nets:nete) :: ttens
1987 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev,nets:nete) :: dptens
1988 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: p
1989 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: dptemp1,dptemp2
1990
1991
1992! NOTE: PGI compiler bug: when using spheremp, rspheremp and ps as pointers to elem(ie)% members,
1993 ! data is incorrect (offset by a few numbers actually)
1994 ! removed for now.
1995 ! real (kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:), pointer :: spheremp,rspheremp
1996 ! real (kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:,:), pointer :: ps
1997
1998 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: lap_t,lap_dp
1999 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2) :: lap_v
2000 real (kind=real_kind) :: v1,v2,dt,heating,utens_tmp,vtens_tmp,ttens_tmp,dptens_tmp
2001
2002
200300 if (nu_s == 0 .and. nu == 0 .and. nu_p==0 ) return;
2004!JMD call t_barrierf('sync_advance_hypervis', hybrid%par%comm)
20057833678336 call t_adj_detailf(+1)
20067833678336 call t_startf('advance_hypervis_dp')
2007
2008
20097833678336 dt=dt2/hypervis_subcycle
2010!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
2011 ! regular viscosity
2012!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
2013 if (hypervis_order == 1) then
201400 if (nu_p>0) call abortmp( 'ERROR: hypervis_order == 1 not coded for nu_p>0')
201500 do ic=1,hypervis_subcycle
201600 do ie=nets,nete
2017
2018#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2019! Not sure about deriv here
2020!$omp parallel do private(k,lap_t,lap_v,deriv,i,j)
2021#endif
202200 do k=1,nlev
2023 ! lap_t=laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
202400 call laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_t,var_coef=.false.)
2025 !lap_v=vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
202600 call vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_v,var_coef=.false.)
2027 ! advace in time. (note: DSS commutes with time stepping, so we
2028 ! can time advance and then DSS. this has the advantage of
2029 ! not letting any discontinuties accumulate in p,v via roundoff
203000 do j=1,np
203100 do i=1,np
2032 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)*elem(ie)%spheremp(i,j) + dt*nu_s*lap_t(i,j)
2033 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)*elem(ie)%spheremp(i,j) + dt*nu*lap_v(i,j,1)
2034 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)*elem(ie)%spheremp(i,j) + dt*nu*lap_v(i,j,2)
2035 enddo
2036 enddo
2037 enddo
2038
203900 kptr=0
204000 call edgeVpack(edge3, elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,nt),nlev,kptr,ie)
204100 kptr=nlev
204200 call edgeVpack(edge3,elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,nt),2*nlev,kptr,ie)
2043 enddo
2044
204500 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3)
2046
204700 do ie=nets,nete
2048
204900 kptr=0
205000 call edgeVunpack(edge3, elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,nt), nlev, kptr, ie)
205100 kptr=nlev
205200 call edgeVunpack(edge3, elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,nt), 2*nlev, kptr, ie)
2053
2054 ! apply inverse mass matrix
2055#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2056!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
2057#endif
205800 do k=1,nlev
205900 do j=1,np
206000 do i=1,np
2061 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)
2062 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)=elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)
2063 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)=elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)
2064 enddo
2065 enddo
2066 enddo
2067 enddo
2068 enddo ! subcycle
2069 endif
2070
2071
2072!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
2073 ! hyper viscosity
2074!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
2075! nu_p=0:
2076! scale T dissipaton by dp (conserve IE, dissipate T^2)
2077! nu_p>0
2078! dont scale: T equation IE dissipation matches (to truncation error)
2079! IE dissipation from continuity equation
2080! (1 deg: to about 0.1 W/m^2)
2081!
20827833678336 if (hypervis_order == 2) then
2083235008313344 do ic=1,hypervis_subcycle
2084235008235008 call biharmonic_wk_dp3d(elem,dptens,ttens,vtens,deriv,edge3,hybrid,nt,nets,nete)
2085705024940032 do ie=nets,nete
2086
2087 ! comptue mean flux
2088705024705024 if (nu_p>0) then
20892115072021855744 do k=1,nlev
2090 !OMP_COLLAPSE_SIMD
2091 !DIR_VECTOR_ALIGNED
209284602880105753600 do j=1,np
2093338411520423014400 do i=1,np
2094 elem(ie)%derived%dpdiss_ave(i,j,k)=elem(ie)%derived%dpdiss_ave(i,j,k)+&
2095 eta_ave_w*elem(ie)%state%dp3d(i,j,k,nt)/hypervis_subcycle
2096 elem(ie)%derived%dpdiss_biharmonic(i,j,k)=elem(ie)%derived%dpdiss_biharmonic(i,j,k)+&
2097 eta_ave_w*dptens(i,j,k,ie)/hypervis_subcycle
2098 enddo
2099 enddo
2100 enddo
2101 endif
2102#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2103!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,lap_t,lap_dp,lap_v,nu_scale_top,dpdn,dpdn0,utens_tmp,vtens_tmp,ttens_tmp,dptens_tmp)
2104#endif
21052115072021855744 do k=1,nlev
2106 ! advace in time.
2107 ! note: DSS commutes with time stepping, so we can time advance and then DSS.
2108 ! note: weak operators alreayd have mass matrix "included"
2109
2110 ! add regular diffusion in top 3 layers:
21112115072042301440 if (nu_top>0 .and. k<=3) then
2112 ! lap_t=laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
211321150726345216 call laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_t,var_coef=.false.)
2114 ! lap_dp=laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%dp3d(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
211521150726345216 call laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%dp3d(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_dp, var_coef=.false.)
2116 ! lap_v=vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
211721150726345216 call vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_v, var_coef=.false.)
2118 endif
21192115072021150720 nu_scale_top = 1
2120705024705024 if (k==1) nu_scale_top=4
21212115072021855744 if (k==2) nu_scale_top=2
2122
2123 ! biharmonic terms need a negative sign:
21242115072042301440 if (nu_top>0 .and. k<=3) then
2125 !OMP_COLLAPSE_SIMD
2126 !DIR_VECTOR_ALIGNED
2127846028810575360 do j=1,np
21283384115242301440 do i=1,np
2129 ttens(i,j,k,ie)=(-nu_s*ttens(i,j,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_t(i,j) )
2130 dptens(i,j,k,ie)=(-nu_p*dptens(i,j,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_dp(i,j) )
2131 vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)=(-nu*vtens(i,j,1,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_v(i,j,1))
2132 vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)=(-nu*vtens(i,j,2,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_v(i,j,2))
2133 enddo
2134 enddo
2135 else
2136 !OMP_COLLAPSE_SIMD
2137 !DIR_VECTOR_ALIGNED
21387614259295178240 do j=1,np
2139304570368380712960 do i=1,np
2140 ttens(i,j,k,ie)=-nu_s*ttens(i,j,k,ie)
2141 dptens(i,j,k,ie)=-nu_p*dptens(i,j,k,ie)
2142 vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)=-nu*vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)
2143 vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)=-nu*vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)
2144 enddo
2145 enddo
2146 endif
2147 enddo
2148
2149
2150705024705024 kptr=0
2151705024705024 call edgeVpack(edge3, ttens(:,:,:,ie),nlev,kptr,ie)
2152705024705024 kptr=nlev
2153705024705024 call edgeVpack(edge3,vtens(:,:,:,:,ie),2*nlev,kptr,ie)
2154705024705024 kptr=3*nlev
2155705024705024 call edgeVpack(edge3,dptens(:,:,:,ie),nlev,kptr, ie)
2156 enddo
2157
2158
2159235008235008 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3)
2160
2161705024940032 do ie=nets,nete
2162
2163705024705024 kptr=0
2164705024705024 call edgeVunpack(edge3, ttens(:,:,:,ie), nlev, kptr, ie)
2165705024705024 kptr=nlev
2166705024705024 call edgeVunpack(edge3, vtens(:,:,:,:,ie), 2*nlev, kptr, ie)
2167705024705024 kptr=3*nlev
2168705024705024 call edgeVunpack(edge3, dptens(:,:,:,ie), nlev, kptr, ie)
2169
2170
2171 ! apply inverse mass matrix, accumulate tendencies
2172#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2173!$omp parallel do private(k)
2174#endif
21752115072021855744 do k=1,nlev
2176338411520634521600 vtens(:,:,1,k,ie)=dt*vtens(:,:,1,k,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
2177338411520634521600 vtens(:,:,2,k,ie)=dt*vtens(:,:,2,k,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
2178338411520634521600 ttens(:,:,k,ie)=dt*ttens(:,:,k,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
2179338411520634521600 dptens(:,:,k,ie)=dt*dptens(:,:,k,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
2180 enddo
2181
2182 ! apply hypervis to u -> u+utens:
2183 ! E0 = dpdn * .5*u dot u + dpdn * T + dpdn*PHIS
2184 ! E1 = dpdn * .5*(u+utens) dot (u+utens) + dpdn * (T-X) + dpdn*PHIS
2185 ! E1-E0: dpdn (u dot utens) + dpdn .5 utens dot utens - dpdn X
2186 ! X = (u dot utens) + .5 utens dot utens
2187 ! alt: (u+utens) dot utens
2188#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2189!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,v1,v2,heating)
2190#endif
21912115072021855744 do k=1,nlev
219284602880105753600 do j=1,np
2193338411520423014400 do i=1,np
2194 ! update v first (gives better results than updating v after heating)
21956768230402707292160 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,:,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,:,k,nt) + &
2196 vtens(i,j,:,k,ie)
2197
2198 v1=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)
2199 v2=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)
2200 heating = (vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)*v1 + vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)*v2 )
2201 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt) &
2202 +ttens(i,j,k,ie)-heating/cp
2203 elem(ie)%state%dp3d(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%dp3d(i,j,k,nt) + &
2204 dptens(i,j,k,ie)
2205 enddo
2206 enddo
2207 enddo
2208 enddo
2209 enddo
2210 endif
2211
22127833678336 call t_stopf('advance_hypervis_dp')
22137833678336 call t_adj_detailf(-1)
2214
2215 end subroutine advance_hypervis_dp
2216
2217
2218
2219
2220
2221
2222 subroutine advance_hypervis_lf(edge3,elem,hvcoord,hybrid,deriv,nm1,n0,nt,nets,nete,dt2)
2223 !
2224 ! take one timestep of:
2225 ! u(:,:,:,np) = u(:,:,:,np) + dt2*nu*laplacian**order ( u )
2226 ! T(:,:,:,np) = T(:,:,:,np) + dt2*nu_s*laplacian**order ( T )
2227 !
2228 !
2229 ! For correct scaling, dt2 should be the same 'dt2' used in the leapfrog advace
2230 !
2231 !
2232 use dimensions_mod, only : np, np, nlev
2233 use control_mod, only : nu, nu_div, nu_s, hypervis_order, hypervis_subcycle, nu_p, nu_top, psurf_vis
2234 use hybrid_mod, only : hybrid_t
2235 use hybvcoord_mod, only : hvcoord_t
2236 use element_mod, only : element_t
2237 use derivative_mod, only : derivative_t, laplace_sphere_wk, vlaplace_sphere_wk
2238 use edgetype_mod, only : EdgeBuffer_t
2239 use edge_mod, only : edgevpack, edgevunpack
2240 use bndry_mod, only : bndry_exchangev
2241 use viscosity_mod, only : biharmonic_wk
2242 use physical_constants, only: Cp
2243! use time_mod, only : TimeLevel_t
2244 implicit none
2245
2246 type (hybrid_t) , intent(in) :: hybrid
2247 type (element_t) , intent(inout), target :: elem(:)
2248 type (EdgeBuffer_t) , intent(inout) :: edge3
2249 type (derivative_t) , intent(in) :: deriv
2250 type (hvcoord_t), intent(in) :: hvcoord
2251! type (TimeLevel_t) , intent(in) :: tl
2252
2253 real (kind=real_kind) :: dt2
2254 integer :: nets,nete
2255
2256 ! local
2257 real (kind=real_kind) :: nu_scale, dpdn,dpdn0, nu_scale_top
2258 integer :: k,kptr,i,j,ie,ic,n0,nt,nm1
2259 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2,nlev,nets:nete) :: vtens
2260 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev,nets:nete) :: ptens
2261 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nets:nete) :: pstens
2262 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: p
2263 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: dXdp
2264
2265
2266! NOTE: PGI compiler bug: when using spheremp, rspheremp and ps as pointers to elem(ie)% members,
2267 ! data is incorrect (offset by a few numbers actually)
2268 ! removed for now.
2269 ! real (kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:), pointer :: spheremp,rspheremp
2270 ! real (kind=real_kind), dimension(:,:,:), pointer :: ps
2271
2272 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: lap_p
2273 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2) :: lap_v
2274 real (kind=real_kind) :: v1,v2,dt,heating,utens_tmp,vtens_tmp,ptens_tmp
2275
2276
2277 if (nu_s == 0 .and. nu == 0 .and. nu_p==0 ) return;
2278!JMD call t_barrierf('sync_advance_hypervis_lf', hybrid%par%comm)
2279 call t_adj_detailf(+1)
2280 call t_startf('advance_hypervis_lf')
2281
2282! for non-leapfrog,nt=n0=nmt
2283!
2284! nm1 = tl%nm1 ! heating term uses U,V at average of nt and nm1 levels
2285! n0 = tl%n0 ! timelevel used for ps scaling. use n0 for leapfrog.
2286! nt = tl%np1 ! apply viscosity to this timelevel (np1)
2287
2288
2289 dt=dt2/hypervis_subcycle
2290!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
2291 ! regular viscosity
2292!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
2293 if (hypervis_order == 1) then
2294 if (nu_p>0) stop 'ERROR: hypervis_order == 1 not coded for nu_p>0'
2295 do ic=1,hypervis_subcycle
2296 do ie=nets,nete
2297
2298#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2299! Not sure about deriv here
2300!$omp parallel do private(k,lap_p,lap_v,deriv,i,j)
2301#endif
2302 do k=1,nlev
2303 !lap_p=laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
2304 call laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_p,var_coef=.false.)
2305 !lap_v=vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
2306 call vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_v,var_coef=.false.)
2307 ! advace in time. (note: DSS commutes with time stepping, so we
2308 ! can time advance and then DSS. this has the advantage of
2309 ! not letting any discontinuties accumulate in p,v via roundoff
2310 do j=1,np
2311 do i=1,np
2312 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)*elem(ie)%spheremp(i,j) + dt*nu_s*lap_p(i,j)
2313 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)*elem(ie)%spheremp(i,j) + dt*nu*lap_v(i,j,1)
2314 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)*elem(ie)%spheremp(i,j) + dt*nu*lap_v(i,j,2)
2315 enddo
2316 enddo
2317 enddo
2318
2319 kptr=0
2320 call edgeVpack(edge3, elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,nt),nlev,kptr,ie)
2321 kptr=nlev
2322 call edgeVpack(edge3,elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,nt),2*nlev,kptr,ie)
2323 enddo
2324
2325 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3)
2326
2327 do ie=nets,nete
2328
2329 kptr=0
2330 call edgeVunpack(edge3, elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,nt), nlev, kptr, ie)
2331 kptr=nlev
2332 call edgeVunpack(edge3, elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,nt), 2*nlev, kptr, ie)
2333
2334 ! apply inverse mass matrix
2335#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2336!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
2337#endif
2338 do k=1,nlev
2339 do j=1,np
2340 do i=1,np
2341 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)
2342 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)=elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)
2343 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)=elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)
2344 enddo
2345 enddo
2346 enddo
2347 enddo
2348 enddo ! subcycle
2349 endif
2350
2351
2352!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
2353 ! hyper viscosity
2354!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
2355 if (hypervis_order == 2) then
2356 do ic=1,hypervis_subcycle
2357 call biharmonic_wk(elem,pstens,ptens,vtens,deriv,edge3,hybrid,nt,nets,nete)
2358 do ie=nets,nete
2359
2360 nu_scale=1
2361#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2362!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,lap_p,lap_v,nu_scale_top,dpdn,dpdn0,nu_scale,utens_tmp,vtens_tmp,ptens_tmp)
2363#endif
2364 do k=1,nlev
2365 ! advace in time.
2366 ! note: DSS commutes with time stepping, so we can time advance and then DSS.
2367 ! note: weak operators alreayd have mass matrix "included"
2368
2369 ! add regular diffusion in top 3 layers:
2370 if (nu_top>0 .and. k<=3) then
2371 ! lap_p=laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
2372 call laplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_p, var_coef=.false.)
2373 ! lap_v=vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.false.)
2374 call vlaplace_sphere_wk(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,nt),deriv,elem(ie),lap_v, var_coef=.false.)
2375 endif
2376 nu_scale_top = 1
2377 if (k==1) nu_scale_top=4
2378 if (k==2) nu_scale_top=2
2379
2380 do j=1,np
2381 do i=1,np
2382 if (psurf_vis==0) then
2383 ! normalize so as to conserve IE (not needed when using p-surface viscosity)
2384 ! scale velosity by 1/rho (normalized to be O(1))
2385 ! dp/dn = O(ps0)*O(delta_eta) = O(ps0)/O(nlev)
2386 dpdn = ( hvcoord%hyai(k+1) - hvcoord%hyai(k) )*hvcoord%ps0 + &
2387 ( hvcoord%hybi(k+1) - hvcoord%hybi(k) )*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(i,j,n0) ! nt ?
2388 dpdn0 = ( hvcoord%hyai(k+1) - hvcoord%hyai(k) )*hvcoord%ps0 + &
2389 ( hvcoord%hybi(k+1) - hvcoord%hybi(k) )*hvcoord%ps0
2390 nu_scale = dpdn0/dpdn
2391 endif
2392
2393 ! biharmonic terms need a negative sign:
2394 if (nu_top>0 .and. k<=3) then
2395 utens_tmp=(-nu*vtens(i,j,1,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_v(i,j,1))
2396 vtens_tmp=(-nu*vtens(i,j,2,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_v(i,j,2))
2397 ptens_tmp=nu_scale*(-nu_s*ptens(i,j,k,ie) + nu_scale_top*nu_top*lap_p(i,j) )
2398 else
2399 utens_tmp=-nu*vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)
2400 vtens_tmp=-nu*vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)
2401 ptens_tmp=-nu_scale*nu_s*ptens(i,j,k,ie)
2402 endif
2403
2404 ptens(i,j,k,ie) = ptens_tmp
2405 vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)=utens_tmp
2406 vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)=vtens_tmp
2407 enddo
2408 enddo
2409 enddo
2410
2411 pstens(:,:,ie) = -nu_p*pstens(:,:,ie)
2412 kptr=0
2413 call edgeVpack(edge3, ptens(:,:,:,ie),nlev,kptr,ie)
2414 kptr=nlev
2415 call edgeVpack(edge3,vtens(:,:,:,:,ie),2*nlev,kptr,ie)
2416 kptr=3*nlev
2417 call edgeVpack(edge3,pstens(:,:,ie),1,kptr,ie)
2418 enddo
2419
2420
2421 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3)
2422
2423 do ie=nets,nete
2424
2425 kptr=0
2426 call edgeVunpack(edge3, ptens(:,:,:,ie), nlev, kptr, ie)
2427 kptr=nlev
2428 call edgeVunpack(edge3, vtens(:,:,:,:,ie), 2*nlev, kptr, ie)
2429 kptr=3*nlev
2430 call edgeVunpack(edge3, pstens(:,:,ie), 1, kptr, ie)
2431
2432 if (psurf_vis == 1 ) then
2433 ! apply p-surface correction
2434 do k=1,nlev
2435 p(:,:,k) = hvcoord%hyam(k)*hvcoord%ps0 + hvcoord%hybm(k)*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nt)
2436 enddo
2437#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2438!$omp parallel do private(k,dXdp)
2439#endif
2440 do k=1,nlev
2441 if (k.eq.1) then
2442 ! no correction needed
2443 else if (k.eq.nlev) then
2444 ! one-sided difference
2445 dXdp = (elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nt) - elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k-1,nt)) / &
2446 (p(:,:,k)-p(:,:,k-1))
2447 ptens(:,:,k,ie) = ptens(:,:,k,ie) - dXdp(:,:)*hvcoord%hybm(k)*pstens(:,:,ie)
2448 else
2449 dXdp = (elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k+1,nt) - elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k-1,nt)) / &
2450 (p(:,:,k+1)-p(:,:,k-1))
2451 ptens(:,:,k,ie) = ptens(:,:,k,ie) - dXdp(:,:)*hvcoord%hybm(k)*pstens(:,:,ie)
2452 endif
2453 enddo
2454 endif
2455
2456
2457 ! apply inverse mass matrix, accumulate tendencies
2458#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2459!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,v1,v2,heating)
2460#endif
2461 do k=1,nlev
2462 do j=1,np
2463 do i=1,np
2464
2465 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt) + &
2466 dt*elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)
2467 elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt) + &
2468 dt*elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)
2469
2470 ! better E conservation if we use v after adding in vtens:
2471 v1=.5*(elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nt)+elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,nm1))
2472 v2=.5*(elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nt)+elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,nm1))
2473 heating = (vtens(i,j,1,k,ie)*v1 + vtens(i,j,2,k,ie)*v2 )
2474
2475 elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt)=elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,nt) + &
2476 dt*elem(ie)%rspheremp(i,j)*(cp*ptens(i,j,k,ie) - heating)/cp
2477
2478 enddo
2479 enddo
2480 enddo
2481 elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nt)=elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nt) + dt*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)*pstens(:,:,ie)
2482 enddo
2483 enddo
2484 endif
2485
2486 call t_stopf('advance_hypervis_lf')
2487 call t_adj_detailf(-1)
2488
2489 end subroutine advance_hypervis_lf
2490

2492 !
2493 ! phl notes: output is stored in first argument. Advances from 2nd argument using tendencies evaluated at 3rd rgument:
2494 ! phl: for offline winds use time at 3rd argument (same as rhs currently)
2495 !
2496391680391680 subroutine compute_and_apply_rhs(np1,nm1,n0,qn0,dt2,elem,hvcoord,hybrid,&
2497 deriv,nets,nete,compute_diagnostics,eta_ave_w)
2498 ! ===================================
2499 ! compute the RHS, accumulate into u(np1) and apply DSS
2500 !
2501 ! u(np1) = u(nm1) + dt2*DSS[ RHS(u(n0)) ]
2502 !
2503 ! This subroutine is normally called to compute a leapfrog timestep
2504 ! but by adjusting np1,nm1,n0 and dt2, many other timesteps can be
2505 ! accomodated. For example, setting nm1=np1=n0 this routine will
2506 ! take a forward euler step, overwriting the input with the output.
2507 !
2508 ! qn0 = timelevel used to access Qdp() in order to compute virtual Temperature
2509 ! qn0=-1 for the dry case
2510 !
2511 ! if dt2<0, then the DSS'd RHS is returned in timelevel np1
2512 !
2513 ! Combining the RHS and DSS pack operation in one routine
2514 ! allows us to fuse these two loops for more cache reuse
2515 !
2516 ! Combining the dt advance and DSS unpack operation in one routine
2517 ! allows us to fuse these two loops for more cache reuse
2518 !
2519 ! note: for prescribed velocity case, velocity will be computed at
2520 ! "real_time", which should be the time of timelevel n0.
2521 !
2522 !
2523 ! ===================================
2524 use kinds, only : real_kind
2525 use dimensions_mod, only : np, np, nlev
2526 use hybrid_mod, only : hybrid_t
2527 use element_mod, only : element_t
2528 use derivative_mod, only : derivative_t, divergence_sphere, gradient_sphere, vorticity_sphere
2529 use edge_mod, only : edgevpack, edgevunpack
2530 use bndry_mod, only : bndry_exchangev
2531 use control_mod, only : moisture, qsplit, use_cpstar, rsplit
2532 use hybvcoord_mod, only : hvcoord_t
2533
2534 use physical_constants, only : cp, cpwater_vapor, Rgas, kappa
2535 use physics_mod, only : virtual_specific_heat, virtual_temperature
2536 use prim_si_mod, only : preq_vertadv, preq_omega_ps, preq_hydrostatic
2537
2538
2539 implicit none
2540 integer, intent(in) :: np1,nm1,n0,qn0,nets,nete
2541 real*8, intent(in) :: dt2
2542 logical, intent(in) :: compute_diagnostics
2543
2544 type (hvcoord_t) , intent(in) :: hvcoord
2545 type (hybrid_t) , intent(in) :: hybrid
2546 type (element_t) , intent(inout), target :: elem(:)
2547 type (derivative_t) , intent(in) :: deriv
2548 real (kind=real_kind) :: eta_ave_w ! weighting for eta_dot_dpdn mean flux
2549
2550 ! local
2551 real (kind=real_kind), pointer, dimension(:,:) :: ps ! surface pressure for current tiime level
2552 real (kind=real_kind), pointer, dimension(:,:,:) :: phi
2553
2554 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: omega_p
2555 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: T_v
2556 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: divdp
2557 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev+1) :: eta_dot_dpdn ! half level vertical velocity on p-grid
2558 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: sdot_sum ! temporary field
2559 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2) :: vtemp ! generic gradient storage
2560 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: vgrad_T ! v.grad(T)
2561 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np) :: Ephi ! kinetic energy + PHI term
2562 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2) :: grad_ps ! lat-lon coord version
2563 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2,nlev) :: grad_p
2564 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: vort ! vorticity
2565 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: p ! pressure
2566 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: dp ! delta pressure
2567 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: rdp ! inverse of delta pressure
2568 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: T_vadv ! temperature vertical advection
2569 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev) :: vgrad_p ! v.grad(p)
2570 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nlev+1) :: ph ! half level pressures on p-grid
2571 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,2,nlev) :: v_vadv ! velocity vertical advection
2572 real (kind=real_kind) :: kappa_star(np,np,nlev)
2573 real (kind=real_kind) :: vtens1(np,np,nlev)
2574 real (kind=real_kind) :: vtens2(np,np,nlev)
2575 real (kind=real_kind) :: ttens(np,np,nlev)
2576
2577 real (kind=real_kind) :: cp2,cp_ratio,E,de,Qt,v1,v2
2578 real (kind=real_kind) :: glnps1,glnps2,gpterm
2579 integer :: i,j,k,kptr,ie
2580
2581!JMD call t_barrierf('sync_compute_and_apply_rhs', hybrid%par%comm)
2582391680391680 call t_adj_detailf(+1)
2583391680391680 call t_startf('compute_and_apply_rhs')
258411750401566720 do ie=nets,nete
2585 !ps => elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0)
258611750401175040 phi => elem(ie)%derived%phi(:,:,:)
2587
2588 ! ==================================================
2589 ! compute pressure (p) on half levels from ps
2590 ! using the hybrid coordinates relationship, i.e.
2591 ! e.g. equation (3.a.92) of the CCM-2 description,
2592 ! (NCAR/TN-382+STR), June 1993, p. 24.
2593 ! ==================================================
2594 ! vertically eulerian only needs grad(ps)
2595 if (rsplit==0) &
259600 call gradient_sphere(elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0),deriv,elem(ie)%Dinv,grad_ps)
2597
2598
2599 ! ============================
2600 ! compute p and delta p
2601 ! ============================
2602!#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2603!!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
2604!#endif
2605! do k=1,nlev+1
2606! ph(:,:,k) = hvcoord%hyai(k)*hvcoord%ps0 + hvcoord%hybi(k)*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0)
2607! end do
2608
2609#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP_BROKEN)
2610! Note that the following does not work with OpenMP threading turned on.
2611! The line
2612! p(:,:,k)=p(:,:,k-1) + dp(:,:,k-1)/2 + dp(:,:,k)/2
2613! is sequential in that it depends upon the previous p(:,:,k-1) and therefore
2614! gives a race condition.
2615! !$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,v1,v2,vtemp)
2616#endif
26173525120036426240 do k=1,nlev
26183525120035251200 if (rsplit==0) then
261900 dp(:,:,k) = (hvcoord%hyai(k+1)*hvcoord%ps0 + hvcoord%hybi(k+1)*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0)) &
2620 - (hvcoord%hyai(k)*hvcoord%ps0 + hvcoord%hybi(k)*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0))
262100 p(:,:,k) = hvcoord%hyam(k)*hvcoord%ps0 + hvcoord%hybm(k)*elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0)
262200 grad_p(:,:,:,k) = hvcoord%hybm(k)*grad_ps(:,:,:)
2623 else
2624 ! vertically lagrangian code: we advect dp3d instead of ps_v
2625 ! we also need grad(p) at all levels (not just grad(ps))
2626 !p(k)= hyam(k)*ps0 + hybm(k)*ps
2627 ! = .5*(hyai(k+1)+hyai(k))*ps0 + .5*(hybi(k+1)+hybi(k))*ps
2628 ! = .5*(ph(k+1) + ph(k) ) = ph(k) + dp(k)/2
2629 !
2630 ! p(k+1)-p(k) = ph(k+1)-ph(k) + (dp(k+1)-dp(k))/2
2631 ! = dp(k) + (dp(k+1)-dp(k))/2 = (dp(k+1)+dp(k))/2
26325640192001057536000 dp(:,:,k) = elem(ie)%state%dp3d(:,:,k,n0)
26333525120035251200 if (k==1) then
26341880064035251200 p(:,:,k)=hvcoord%hyai(k)*hvcoord%ps0 + dp(:,:,k)/2
2635 else
26365452185601022284800 p(:,:,k)=p(:,:,k-1) + dp(:,:,k-1)/2 + dp(:,:,k)/2
2637 endif
2638 ! grad_p(:,:,:,k) = gradient_sphere(p(:,:,k),deriv,elem(ie)%Dinv)
26393525120035251200 call gradient_sphere(p(:,:,k),deriv,elem(ie)%Dinv,grad_p(:,:,:,k))
2640 endif
2641
26425640192001057536000 rdp(:,:,k) = 1.0D0/dp(:,:,k)
2643
2644 ! ============================
2645 ! compute vgrad_lnps
2646 ! ============================
2647141004800176256000 do j=1,np
2648564019200705024000 do i=1,np
2649 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
2650 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
2651! vgrad_p(i,j,k) = &
2652! hvcoord%hybm(k)*(v1*grad_ps(i,j,1) + v2*grad_ps(i,j,2))
2653 vgrad_p(i,j,k) = (v1*grad_p(i,j,1,k) + v2*grad_p(i,j,2,k))
2654 vtemp(i,j,1) = v1*dp(i,j,k)
2655 vtemp(i,j,2) = v2*dp(i,j,k)
2656 end do
2657 end do
2658
2659
2660
2661 ! ================================
2662 ! Accumulate mean Vel_rho flux in vn0
2663 ! ================================
266411280384004512153600 elem(ie)%derived%vn0(:,:,:,k)=elem(ie)%derived%vn0(:,:,:,k)+eta_ave_w*vtemp(:,:,:)
2665
2666
2667 ! =========================================
2668 !
2669 ! Compute relative vorticity and divergence
2670 !
2671 ! =========================================
2672 ! divdp(:,:,k)=divergence_sphere(vtemp,deriv,elem(ie))
26733525120035251200 call divergence_sphere(vtemp,deriv,elem(ie),divdp(:,:,k))
2674 ! vort(:,:,k)=vorticity_sphere(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,n0),deriv,elem(ie))
267535251200105753600 call vorticity_sphere(elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,n0),deriv,elem(ie),vort(:,:,k))
2676
2677 enddo
2678
2679 ! compute T_v for timelevel n0
2680 !if ( moisture /= "dry") then
268111750401175040 if (qn0 == -1 ) then
2682#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2683!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
2684#endif
268500 do k=1,nlev
268600 do j=1,np
268700 do i=1,np
2688 T_v(i,j,k) = elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)
2689 kappa_star(i,j,k) = kappa
2690 end do
2691 end do
2692 end do
2693 else
2694#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2695!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,Qt)
2696#endif
2697
26983525120036426240 do k=1,nlev
2699141004800176256000 do j=1,np
2700564019200705024000 do i=1,np
2701 ! Qt = elem(ie)%state%Q(i,j,k,1)
2702564019200564019200 Qt = elem(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,1,qn0)/dp(i,j,k)
2703!!XXgoldyXX
2704!Qt=0._real_kind
2705!!XXgoldyXX
27065640192001128038400 T_v(i,j,k) = Virtual_Temperature(elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0),Qt)
2707 if (use_cpstar==1) then
270800 kappa_star(i,j,k) = Rgas/Virtual_Specific_Heat(Qt)
2709 else
2710564019200564019200 kappa_star(i,j,k) = kappa
2711 endif
2712 end do
2713 end do
2714 end do
2715 end if
