2717
2718 ! ====================================================
2719 ! Compute Hydrostatic equation, modeld after CCM-3
2720 ! ====================================================
2721 !call geopotential_t(p,dp,T_v,Rgas,phi)
272211750408225280 call preq_hydrostatic(phi,elem(ie)%state%phis,T_v,p,dp)
2723
2724 ! ====================================================
2725 ! Compute omega_p according to CCM-3
2726 ! ====================================================
272711750401175040 call preq_omega_ps(omega_p,hvcoord,p,vgrad_p,divdp)
2728
2729
2730 ! ==================================================
2731 ! zero partial sum for accumulating sum
2732 ! (div(v_k) + v_k.grad(lnps))*dsigma_k = div( v dp )
2733 ! used by eta_dot_dpdn and lnps tendency
2734 ! ==================================================
27351880064035251200 sdot_sum=0
2736
2737
2738 ! ==================================================
2739 ! Compute eta_dot_dpdn
2740 ! save sdot_sum as this is the -RHS of ps_v equation
2741 ! ==================================================
274211750401175040 if (rsplit>0) then
2743 ! VERTICALLY LAGRANGIAN: no vertical motion
27445828198401131563520 eta_dot_dpdn=0
27455640192001095137280 T_vadv=0
274611280384002293678080 v_vadv=0
2747 else
274800 do k=1,nlev
2749 ! ==================================================
2750 ! add this term to PS equation so we exactly conserve dry mass
2751 ! ==================================================
275200 sdot_sum(:,:) = sdot_sum(:,:) + divdp(:,:,k)
275300 eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k+1) = sdot_sum(:,:)
2754 end do
2755
2756
2757 ! ===========================================================
2758 ! at this point, eta_dot_dpdn contains integral_etatop^eta[ divdp ]
2759 ! compute at interfaces:
2760 ! eta_dot_dpdn = -dp/dt - integral_etatop^eta[ divdp ]
2761 ! for reference: at mid layers we have:
2762 ! omega = v grad p - integral_etatop^eta[ divdp ]
2763 ! ===========================================================
2764#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2765 !$omp parallel do private(k)
2766#endif
276700 do k=1,nlev-1
276800 eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k+1) = hvcoord%hybi(k+1)*sdot_sum(:,:) - eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k+1)
2769 end do
2770
277100 eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,1 ) = 0.0D0
277200 eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,nlev+1) = 0.0D0
2773
2774 ! ===========================================================
2775 ! Compute vertical advection of T and v from eq. CCM2 (3.b.1)
2776 ! ==============================================
277700 call preq_vertadv(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,n0),elem(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,n0), &
2778 eta_dot_dpdn,rdp,T_vadv,v_vadv)
2779 endif
2780
2781
2782 ! ================================
2783 ! accumulate mean vertical flux:
2784 ! ================================
2785#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2786 !$omp parallel do private(k)
2787#endif
27883525120036426240 do k=1,nlev ! Loop index added (AAM)
27895640192002115072000 elem(ie)%derived%eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k) = &
2790 elem(ie)%derived%eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k) + eta_ave_w*eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k)
27915640192002115072000 elem(ie)%derived%omega_p(:,:,k) = &
2792 elem(ie)%derived%omega_p(:,:,k) + eta_ave_w*omega_p(:,:,k)
2793 enddo
27941880064070502400 elem(ie)%derived%eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,nlev+1) = &
2795 elem(ie)%derived%eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,nlev+1) + eta_ave_w*eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,nlev+1)
2796
2797
2798
2799
2800
2801 ! ==============================================
2802 ! Compute phi + kinetic energy term: 10*nv*nv Flops
2803 ! ==============================================
2804#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
2805!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,v1,v2,E,Ephi,vtemp,vgrad_T,gpterm,glnps1,glnps2)
2806#endif
28073525120036426240 do k=1,nlev
2808141004800176256000 do j=1,np
2809564019200705024000 do i=1,np
2810 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
2811 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
2812 E = 0.5D0*( v1*v1 + v2*v2 )
2813 Ephi(i,j)=E+phi(i,j,k)+elem(ie)%derived%pecnd(i,j,k)
2814 end do
2815 end do
2816 ! ================================================
2817 ! compute gradp term (ps/p)*(dp/dps)*T
2818 ! ================================================
2819 ! vtemp(:,:,:) = gradient_sphere(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,n0),deriv,elem(ie)%Dinv)
282035251200105753600 call gradient_sphere(elem(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,n0),deriv,elem(ie)%Dinv,vtemp(:,:,:))
2821141004800176256000 do j=1,np
2822564019200705024000 do i=1,np
2823 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
2824 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
2825 vgrad_T(i,j) = v1*vtemp(i,j,1) + v2*vtemp(i,j,2)
2826 end do
2827 end do
2828
2829
2830 ! vtemp = grad ( E + PHI )
2831 ! vtemp = gradient_sphere(Ephi(:,:),deriv,elem(ie)%Dinv)
28323525120035251200 call gradient_sphere(Ephi(:,:),deriv,elem(ie)%Dinv,vtemp)
2833
2834141004800176256000 do j=1,np
2835564019200705024000 do i=1,np
2836! gpterm = hvcoord%hybm(k)*T_v(i,j,k)/p(i,j,k)
2837! glnps1 = Rgas*gpterm*grad_ps(i,j,1)
2838! glnps2 = Rgas*gpterm*grad_ps(i,j,2)
2839 gpterm = T_v(i,j,k)/p(i,j,k)
2840 glnps1 = Rgas*gpterm*grad_p(i,j,1,k)
2841 glnps2 = Rgas*gpterm*grad_p(i,j,2,k)
2842
2843 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
2844 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
2845
2846 vtens1(i,j,k) = - v_vadv(i,j,1,k) &
2847 + v2*(elem(ie)%fcor(i,j) + vort(i,j,k)) &
2848 - vtemp(i,j,1) - glnps1
2849 !
2850 ! phl: add forcing term to zonal wind u
2851 !
2852 vtens2(i,j,k) = - v_vadv(i,j,2,k) &
2853 - v1*(elem(ie)%fcor(i,j) + vort(i,j,k)) &
2854 - vtemp(i,j,2) - glnps2
2855 !
2856 ! phl: add forcing term to meridional wind v
2857 !
2858 ttens(i,j,k) = - T_vadv(i,j,k) - vgrad_T(i,j) + kappa_star(i,j,k)*T_v(i,j,k)*omega_p(i,j,k)
2859 !
2860 ! phl: add forcing term to T
2861 !
2862 end do
2863 end do
2864
2865 end do
2866
2867#ifdef ENERGY_DIAGNOSTICS
2868 ! =========================================================
2869 !
2870 ! diagnostics
2871 ! recomputes some gradients that were not saved above
2872 ! uses: sdot_sum(), eta_dot_dpdn(), grad_ps()
2873 ! grad_phi(), dp(), p(), T_vadv(), v_vadv(), divdp()
2874 ! =========================================================
2875
2876 ! =========================================================
2877 ! (AAM) - This section has accumulations over vertical levels.
2878 ! Be careful if implementing OpenMP
2879 ! =========================================================
2880
2881 if (compute_diagnostics) then
2882 elem(ie)%accum%KEhorz1=0
2883 elem(ie)%accum%KEhorz2=0
2884 elem(ie)%accum%IEhorz1=0
2885 elem(ie)%accum%IEhorz2=0
2886 elem(ie)%accum%IEhorz1_wet=0
2887 elem(ie)%accum%IEhorz2_wet=0
2888 elem(ie)%accum%KEvert1=0
2889 elem(ie)%accum%KEvert2=0
2890 elem(ie)%accum%IEvert1=0
2891 elem(ie)%accum%IEvert2=0
2892 elem(ie)%accum%IEvert1_wet=0
2893 elem(ie)%accum%IEvert2_wet=0
2894 elem(ie)%accum%T1=0
2895 elem(ie)%accum%T2=0
2896 elem(ie)%accum%T2_s=0
2897 elem(ie)%accum%S1=0
2898 elem(ie)%accum%S1_wet=0
2899 elem(ie)%accum%S2=0
2900
2901 do j=1,np
2902 do i=1,np
2903 elem(ie)%accum%S2(i,j) = elem(ie)%accum%S2(i,j) - &
2904 sdot_sum(i,j)*elem(ie)%state%phis(i,j)
2905 enddo
2906 enddo
2907
2908 do k=1,nlev
2909 ! vtemp = grad_E(:,:,k)
2910 do j=1,np
2911 do i=1,np
2912 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
2913 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
2914 Ephi(i,j)=0.5D0*( v1*v1 + v2*v2 )

2916 enddo
2917 ! vtemp = gradient_sphere(Ephi,deriv,elem(ie)%Dinv)
2918 call gradient_sphere(Ephi,deriv,elem(ie)%Dinv,vtemp)
2919 do j=1,np

2922 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
2923 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
2924 elem(ie)%accum%KEhorz2(i,j) = elem(ie)%accum%KEhorz2(i,j) + &
2925 (v1*vtemp(i,j,1) + v2*vtemp(i,j,2))*dp(i,j,k)

2930 elem(ie)%accum%IEhorz1(i,j) = elem(ie)%accum%IEhorz1(i,j) + Cp*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)*divdp(i,j,k)
2931

2934 enddo
2935

2940 do j=1,np
2941 do i=1,np
2942 v1 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
2943 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
2944 E = 0.5D0*( v1*v1 + v2*v2 )
2945 ! NOTE: Cp_star = Cp + (Cpv-Cp)*q
2946 ! advection terms can thus be broken into two components: dry and wet
2947 ! dry components cancel exactly

2950 ! some diagnostics

2952 de = eta_dot_dpdn(i,j,k+1)-eta_dot_dpdn(i,j,k)
2953 ! Cp T de/dn, integral dn:
2954 elem(ie)%accum%IEvert1(i,j)=elem(ie)%accum%IEvert1(i,j) + Cp*elem(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)*de
2955 ! E de/dn

2957 ! Cp T_vadv dp/dn
2958 elem(ie)%accum%IEvert2(i,j)=elem(ie)%accum%IEvert2(i,j) + Cp*T_vadv(i,j,k)*dp(i,j,k)
2959 ! dp/dn V dot V_vadv
2960 elem(ie)%accum%KEvert2(i,j)=elem(ie)%accum%KEvert2(i,j) + (v1*v_vadv(i,j,1,k) + v2*v_vadv(i,j,2,k)) *dp(i,j,k)
2961
2962 ! IEvert1_wet(): (Cpv-Cp) T Qdp_vadv (Q equation)

2966 (Cpwater_vapor-Cp)*elem(ie)%state%Q(i,j,k,1)*T_vadv(i,j,k)*dp(i,j,k)

2972

3005 do j=1,np

3008 v2 = elem(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)

3139 subroutine residual(xstate, fx, nelemd, c_ptr_to_object) bind(C,name='calc_f')

3141 ! ===================================
3142 ! compute the RHS, accumulate into a residual for each dependent variable and apply DSS
3143 !
3144 ! For the Backward Euler first order option
3145 !
3146 ! F(u) = (u(np1) - u(n0))/dt - DSS[ RHS(u(np1)) ]
3147 !
3148 ! For the BDF2 second order option
3149 !
3150 ! F(u) = (u(np1) - u(n0))/dt - DSS[ RHS(u(np1)) ]
3151 !
3152 ! This subroutine is normally called to compute a leapfrog timestep
3153 ! but by adjusting np1,nm1,n0 and dt2, many other timesteps can be
3154 ! accomodated. For example, setting nm1=np1=n0 this routine will
3155 ! take a forward euler step, overwriting the input with the output.
3156 !
3157 ! qn0 = timelevel used to access Qdp() in order to compute virtual Temperature
3158 ! qn0=-1 for the dry case
3159 !
3160 ! if dt2<0, then the DSS'd RHS is returned in timelevel np1
3161 !
3162 ! Combining the RHS and DSS pack operation in one routine
3163 ! allows us to fuse these two loops for more cache reuse
3164 !
3165 ! Combining the dt advance and DSS unpack operation in one routine
3166 ! allows us to fuse these two loops for more cache reuse
3167 !
3168 ! note: for prescribed velocity case, velocity will be computed at
3169 ! "real_time", which should be the time of timelevel n0.
3170 !
3171 !
3172 ! ===================================

3332! ps => fptr%base(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0)

3335 ! ==================================================
3336 ! compute pressure (p) on half levels from ps
3337 ! using the hybrid coordinates relationship, i.e.
3338 ! e.g. equation (3.a.92) of the CCM-2 description,
3339 ! (NCAR/TN-382+STR), June 1993, p. 24.
3340 ! ==================================================

3343 call gradient_sphere(fptr%base(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv,grad_ps)
3344
3345 ! ============================
3346 ! compute p and delta p

3348!#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
3349!!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
3350!#endif

3355#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)

3357#endif
3358 do k=1,nlev
3359 if (rsplit==0) then
3360 dp(:,:,k) = (hvcoord%hyai(k+1)*hvcoord%ps0 + hvcoord%hybi(k+1)*fptr%base(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0)) &
3361 - (hvcoord%hyai(k)*hvcoord%ps0 + hvcoord%hybi(k)*fptr%base(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0))
3362 p(:,:,k) = hvcoord%hyam(k)*hvcoord%ps0 + hvcoord%hybm(k)*fptr%base(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,n0)
3363 grad_p(:,:,:,k) = hvcoord%hybm(k)*grad_ps(:,:,:)
3364
3365 else
3366 ! vertically lagrangian code: we advect dp3d instead of ps_v
3367 ! we also need grad(p) at all levels (not just grad(ps))
3368 !p(k)= hyam(k)*ps0 + hybm(k)*ps
3369 ! = .5*(hyai(k+1)+hyai(k))*ps0 + .5*(hybi(k+1)+hybi(k))*ps
3370 ! = .5*(ph(k+1) + ph(k) ) = ph(k) + dp(k)/2
3371 !
3372 ! p(k+1)-p(k) = ph(k+1)-ph(k) + (dp(k+1)-dp(k))/2
3373 ! = dp(k) + (dp(k+1)-dp(k))/2 = (dp(k+1)+dp(k))/2
3374 dp(:,:,k) = fptr%base(ie)%state%dp3d(:,:,k,n0)
3375 if (k==1) then
3376 p(:,:,k)=hvcoord%hyai(k)*hvcoord%ps0 + dp(:,:,k)/2
3377 else
3378 p(:,:,k)=p(:,:,k-1) + dp(:,:,k-1)/2 + dp(:,:,k)/2
3379 endif
3380 ! grad_p(:,:,:,k) = gradient_sphere(p(:,:,k),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv)
3381 call gradient_sphere(p(:,:,k),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv,grad_p(:,:,:,k))
3382 endif
3383
3384 rdp(:,:,k) = 1.0D0/dp(:,:,k)
3385
3386 ! ============================
3387 ! compute vgrad_lnps
3388 ! ============================
3389 do j=1,np
3390 do i=1,np
3391 v1 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
3392 v2 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
3393! vgrad_p(i,j,k) = &
3394! hvcoord%hybm(k)*(v1*grad_ps(i,j,1) + v2*grad_ps(i,j,2))
3395 vgrad_p(i,j,k) = (v1*grad_p(i,j,1,k) + v2*grad_p(i,j,2,k))
3396 vtemp(i,j,1) = v1*dp(i,j,k)
3397 vtemp(i,j,2) = v2*dp(i,j,k)
3398 end do
3399 end do
3400
3401 ! ================================
3402 ! Accumulate mean Vel_rho flux in vn0
3403 ! ================================
3404 fptr%base(ie)%derived%vn0(:,:,:,k)=fptr%base(ie)%derived%vn0(:,:,:,k)+eta_ave_w*vtemp(:,:,:)
3405
3406
3407 ! =========================================
3408 !
3409 ! Compute relative vorticity and divergence
3410 !
3411 ! =========================================
3412 ! divdp(:,:,k)=divergence_sphere(vtemp,deriv,fptr%base(ie))
3413 call divergence_sphere(vtemp,deriv,fptr%base(ie),divdp(:,:,k))
3414 !vort(:,:,k)=vorticity_sphere(fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,n0),deriv,fptr%base(ie))
3415 call vorticity_sphere(fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,k,n0),deriv,fptr%base(ie),vort(:,:,k))
3416
3417 enddo
3418
3419 ! compute T_v for timelevel n0
3420 !if ( moisture /= "dry") then
3421 if (qn0 == -1 ) then
3422#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
3423!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j)
3424#endif
3425 do k=1,nlev
3426 do j=1,np
3427 do i=1,np
3428 T_v(i,j,k) = fptr%base(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)
3429 kappa_star(i,j,k) = kappa
3430 end do
3431 end do
3432 end do
3433 else
3434#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
3435!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,Qt)
3436#endif
3437 do k=1,nlev
3438 do j=1,np
3439 do i=1,np
3440 ! Qt = fptr%base(ie)%state%Q(i,j,k,1)
3441 Qt = fptr%base(ie)%state%Qdp(i,j,k,1,qn0)/dp(i,j,k)
3442 T_v(i,j,k) = Virtual_Temperature(fptr%base(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0),Qt)
3443 if (use_cpstar==1) then
3444 kappa_star(i,j,k) = Rgas/Virtual_Specific_Heat(Qt)
3445 else
3446 kappa_star(i,j,k) = kappa
3447 endif
3448 end do
3449 end do
3450 end do
3451 end if
3452
3453 ! ====================================================
3454 ! Compute Hydrostatic equation, modeld after CCM-3
3455 ! ====================================================
3456 !call geopotential_t(p,dp,T_v,Rgas,fptr%base(ie)%derived%phi)
3457 call preq_hydrostatic(fptr%base(ie)%derived%phi,fptr%base(ie)%state%phis,T_v,p,dp)
3458
3459 ! ====================================================
3460 ! Compute omega_p according to CCM-3
3461 ! ====================================================
3462 call preq_omega_ps(omega_p,hvcoord,p,vgrad_p,divdp)
3463
3464 ! ==================================================
3465 ! zero partial sum for accumulating sum
3466 ! (div(v_k) + v_k.grad(lnps))*dsigma_k = div( v dp )
3467 ! used by eta_dot_dpdn and lnps tendency
3468 ! ==================================================
3469 sdot_sum=0
3470
3471 ! ==================================================
3472 ! Compute eta_dot_dpdn
3473 ! save sdot_sum as this is the -RHS of ps_v equation
3474 ! ==================================================
3475 if (rsplit>0) then
3476 ! VERTICALLY LAGRANGIAN: no vertical motion
3477 eta_dot_dpdn=0
3478 T_vadv=0
3479 v_vadv=0
3480 else
3481 do k=1,nlev
3482 ! ==================================================
3483 ! add this term to PS equation so we exactly conserve dry mass
3484 ! ==================================================
3485 sdot_sum(:,:) = sdot_sum(:,:) + divdp(:,:,k)
3486 eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k+1) = sdot_sum(:,:)
3487 end do
3488
3489 ! ===========================================================
3490 ! at this point, eta_dot_dpdn contains integral_etatop^eta[ divdp ]
3491 ! compute at interfaces:
3492 ! eta_dot_dpdn = -dp/dt - integral_etatop^eta[ divdp ]
3493 ! for reference: at mid layers we have:
3494 ! omega = v grad p - integral_etatop^eta[ divdp ]
3495 ! ===========================================================
3496#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
3497 !$omp parallel do private(k)
3498#endif
3499 do k=1,nlev-1
3500 eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k+1) = hvcoord%hybi(k+1)*sdot_sum(:,:) - eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k+1)
3501 end do
3502
3503 eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,1 ) = 0.0D0
3504 eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,nlev+1) = 0.0D0
3505
3506 ! ===========================================================
3507 ! Compute vertical advection of T and v from eq. CCM2 (3.b.1)
3508 ! ==============================================
3509 call preq_vertadv(fptr%base(ie)%state%T(:,:,:,n0),fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,:,:,n0), &
3510 eta_dot_dpdn,rdp,T_vadv,v_vadv)
3511 endif
3512
3513 ! ================================
3514 ! accumulate mean vertical flux:
3515 ! ================================
3516#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
3517 !$omp parallel do private(k)
3518#endif
3519 do k=1,nlev ! Loop index added (AAM)
3520 fptr%base(ie)%derived%eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k) = &
3521 fptr%base(ie)%derived%eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k) + eta_ave_w*eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,k)
3522 fptr%base(ie)%derived%omega_p(:,:,k) = &
3523 fptr%base(ie)%derived%omega_p(:,:,k) + eta_ave_w*omega_p(:,:,k)
3524 enddo
3525 fptr%base(ie)%derived%eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,nlev+1) = &
3526 fptr%base(ie)%derived%eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,nlev+1) + eta_ave_w*eta_dot_dpdn(:,:,nlev+1)
3527
3528
3529 ! ==============================================
3530 ! Compute phi + kinetic energy term: 10*np*np Flops
3531 ! ==============================================
3532#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
3533!$omp parallel do private(k,i,j,v1,v2,E,Ephi,vtemp,vgrad_T,gpterm,glnps1,glnps2)
3534#endif
3535 do k=1,nlev
3536 do j=1,np
3537 do i=1,np
3538 v1 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
3539 v2 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
3540 E = 0.5D0*( v1*v1 + v2*v2 )
3541 Ephi(i,j)=E+fptr%base(ie)%derived%phi(i,j,k)+fptr%base(ie)%derived%pecnd(i,j,k)
3542 end do
3543 end do
3544 ! ================================================
3545 ! compute gradp term (ps/p)*(dp/dps)*T
3546 ! ================================================
3547 !vtemp(:,:,:) = gradient_sphere(fptr%base(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,n0),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv)
3548 call gradient_sphere(fptr%base(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,n0),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv,vtemp)
3549 do j=1,np
3550 do i=1,np
3551 v1 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
3552 v2 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
3553 vgrad_T(i,j) = v1*vtemp(i,j,1) + v2*vtemp(i,j,2)
3554 end do
3555 end do
3556
3557
3558 ! vtemp = grad ( E + PHI )
3559 !vtemp = gradient_sphere(Ephi(:,:),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv)
3560 call gradient_sphere(Ephi(:,:),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv,vtemp)
3561
3562 do j=1,np
3563 do i=1,np
3564! gpterm = hvcoord%hybm(k)*T_v(i,j,k)/p(i,j,k)
3565! glnps1 = Rgas*gpterm*grad_ps(i,j,1)
3566! glnps2 = Rgas*gpterm*grad_ps(i,j,2)
3567 gpterm = T_v(i,j,k)/p(i,j,k)
3568 glnps1 = Rgas*gpterm*grad_p(i,j,1,k)
3569 glnps2 = Rgas*gpterm*grad_p(i,j,2,k)
3570
3571 v1 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
3572 v2 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
3573
3574 vtens1(i,j,k) = - v_vadv(i,j,1,k) &
3575 + v2*(fptr%base(ie)%fcor(i,j) + vort(i,j,k)) &
3576 - vtemp(i,j,1) - glnps1
3577
3578 vtens2(i,j,k) = - v_vadv(i,j,2,k) &
3579 - v1*(fptr%base(ie)%fcor(i,j) + vort(i,j,k)) &
3580 - vtemp(i,j,2) - glnps2
3581
3582 ttens(i,j,k) = - T_vadv(i,j,k) - vgrad_T(i,j) + kappa_star(i,j,k)*T_v(i,j,k)*omega_p(i,j,k)
3583
3584 end do
3585 end do
3586
3587 end do
3588
3589#ifdef ENERGY_DIAGNOSTICS
3590 ! =========================================================
3591 !
3592 ! diagnostics
3593 ! recomputes some gradients that were not saved above
3594 ! uses: sdot_sum(), eta_dot_dpdn(), grad_ps()
3595 ! grad_phi(), dp(), p(), T_vadv(), v_vadv(), divdp()
3596 ! =========================================================
3597
3598 ! =========================================================
3599 ! (AAM) - This section has accumulations over vertical levels.
3600 ! Be careful if implementing OpenMP
3601 ! =========================================================
3602
3603 if (compute_diagnostics) then
3604 fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEhorz1=0
3605 fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEhorz2=0
3606 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz1=0
3607 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz2=0
3608 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz1_wet=0
3609 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz2_wet=0
3610 fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEvert1=0
3611 fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEvert2=0
3612 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert1=0
3613 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert2=0
3614 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert1_wet=0
3615 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert2_wet=0
3616 fptr%base(ie)%accum%T1=0
3617 fptr%base(ie)%accum%T2=0
3618 fptr%base(ie)%accum%T2_s=0
3619 fptr%base(ie)%accum%S1=0
3620 fptr%base(ie)%accum%S1_wet=0
3621 fptr%base(ie)%accum%S2=0
3622
3623 do j=1,np
3624 do i=1,np
3625 fptr%base(ie)%accum%S2(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%S2(i,j) - &
3626 sdot_sum(i,j)*fptr%base(ie)%state%phis(i,j)
3627 enddo
3628 enddo
3629
3630 do k=1,nlev
3631 ! vtemp = grad_E(:,:,k)
3632 do j=1,np
3633 do i=1,np
3634 v1 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
3635 v2 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
3636 Ephi(i,j)=0.5D0*( v1*v1 + v2*v2 )
3637 enddo
3638 enddo
3639 ! vtemp = gradient_sphere(Ephi,deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv)
3640 call gradient_sphere(Ephi,deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv,vtemp)
3641 do j=1,np
3642 do i=1,np
3643 ! dp/dn u dot grad(E)
3644 v1 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
3645 v2 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
3646 fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEhorz2(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEhorz2(i,j) + &
3647 (v1*vtemp(i,j,1) + v2*vtemp(i,j,2))*dp(i,j,k)
3648 ! E div( u dp/dn )
3649 fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEhorz1(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEhorz1(i,j) + Ephi(i,j)*divdp(i,j,k)
3650
3651 ! Cp T div( u dp/dn) ! dry horizontal advection component
3652 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz1(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz1(i,j) + Cp*fptr%base(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)*divdp(i,j,k)
3653
3654
3655 enddo
3656 enddo
3657
3658
3659 ! vtemp = grad_phi(:,:,k)
3660 ! vtemp = gradient_sphere(phi(:,:,k),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv)
3661 call gradient_sphere(phi(:,:,k),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv,vtemp)
3662 do j=1,np
3663 do i=1,np
3664 v1 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
3665 v2 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
3666 E = 0.5D0*( v1*v1 + v2*v2 )
3667 ! NOTE: Cp_star = Cp + (Cpv-Cp)*q
3668 ! advection terms can thus be broken into two components: dry and wet
3669 ! dry components cancel exactly
3670 ! wet components should cancel exactly
3671 !
3672 ! some diagnostics
3673 ! e = eta_dot_dpdn()
3674 de = eta_dot_dpdn(i,j,k+1)-eta_dot_dpdn(i,j,k)
3675 ! Cp T de/dn, integral dn:
3676 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert1(i,j)=fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert1(i,j) + Cp*fptr%base(ie)%state%T(i,j,k,n0)*de
3677 ! E de/dn
3678 fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEvert1(i,j)=fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEvert1(i,j) + E*de
3679 ! Cp T_vadv dp/dn
3680 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert2(i,j)=fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert2(i,j) + Cp*T_vadv(i,j,k)*dp(i,j,k)
3681 ! dp/dn V dot V_vadv
3682 fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEvert2(i,j)=fptr%base(ie)%accum%KEvert2(i,j) + (v1*v_vadv(i,j,1,k) + v2*v_vadv(i,j,2,k)) *dp(i,j,k)
3683
3684 ! IEvert1_wet(): (Cpv-Cp) T Qdp_vadv (Q equation)
3685 ! IEvert2_wet(): (Cpv-Cp) Qdp T_vadv T equation
3686 if (use_cpstar==1) then
3687 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert2_wet(i,j)=fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEvert2_wet(i,j) +&
3688 (Cpwater_vapor-Cp)*fptr%base(ie)%state%Q(i,j,k,1)*T_vadv(i,j,k)*dp(i,j,k)
3689 endif
3690
3691 gpterm = T_v(i,j,k)/p(i,j,k)
3692 fptr%base(ie)%accum%T1(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%T1(i,j) - &
3693 Rgas*gpterm*(grad_p(i,j,1,k)*v1 + grad_p(i,j,2,k)*v2)*dp(i,j,k)
3694
3695 fptr%base(ie)%accum%T2(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%T2(i,j) - &
3696 (vtemp(i,j,1)*v1 + vtemp(i,j,2)*v2)*dp(i,j,k)
3697
3698 ! S1 = < Cp_star dp/dn , RT omega_p/cp_star >
3699 fptr%base(ie)%accum%S1(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%S1(i,j) + &
3700 Rgas*T_v(i,j,k)*omega_p(i,j,k)*dp(i,j,k)
3701
3702 ! cp_star = cp + cp2
3703 if (use_cpstar==1) then
3704 cp2 = (Cpwater_vapor-Cp)*fptr%base(ie)%state%Q(i,j,k,1)
3705 cp_ratio = cp2/(cp+cp2)
3706 fptr%base(ie)%accum%S1_wet(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%S1_wet(i,j) + &
3707 cp_ratio*(Rgas*T_v(i,j,k)*omega_p(i,j,k)*dp(i,j,k))
3708 endif
3709
3710 fptr%base(ie)%accum%CONV(i,j,:,k)=-Rgas*gpterm*grad_p(i,j,:,k)-vtemp(i,j,:)
3711 enddo
3712 enddo
3713
3714 ! vtemp(:,:,:) = gradient_sphere(fptr%base(ie)%state%phis(:,:),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv)
3715 call gradient_sphere(fptr%base(ie)%state%phis(:,:),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv,vtemp)
3716 do j=1,np
3717 do i=1,np
3718 v1 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
3719 v2 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
3720 fptr%base(ie)%accum%T2_s(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%T2_s(i,j) - &
3721 (vtemp(i,j,1)*v1 + vtemp(i,j,2)*v2)*dp(i,j,k)
3722 enddo
3723 enddo
3724
3725 ! vtemp(:,:,:) = gradient_sphere(fptr%base(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,n0),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv)
3726 call gradient_sphere(fptr%base(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,n0),deriv,fptr%base(ie)%Dinv,vtemp)
3727 do j=1,np
3728 do i=1,np
3729 v1 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,1,k,n0)
3730 v2 = fptr%base(ie)%state%v(i,j,2,k,n0)
3731
3732 ! Cp dp/dn u dot gradT
3733 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz2(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz2(i,j) + &
3734 Cp*(v1*vtemp(i,j,1) + v2*vtemp(i,j,2))*dp(i,j,k)
3735
3736 if (use_cpstar==1) then
3737 fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz2_wet(i,j) = fptr%base(ie)%accum%IEhorz2_wet(i,j) + &
3738 (Cpwater_vapor-Cp)*fptr%base(ie)%state%Q(i,j,k,1)*&
3739 (v1*vtemp(i,j,1) + v2*vtemp(i,j,2))*dp(i,j,k)
3740 endif
3741
3742 enddo
3743 enddo
3744
3745 enddo
3746 endif
3747#endif
3748
3749 ! =========================================================
3750 ! local element timestep, store in np1.
3751 ! apply mass matrix
3752 ! =========================================================
3753
3754#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
3755!$omp parallel do private(k)
3756#endif
3757
3758! for BE, gam = 0. For BDF2, gam = 0.5
3759 do k=1,nlev
3760 fttens(:,:,k,ie) = fptr%base(ie)%spheremp(:,:)* &
3761 ( (1+gam)*(fptr%base(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,np1) - fptr%base(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nm1))*dti - &
3762 gam*(fptr%base(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nm1) - fptr%base(ie)%state%T(:,:,k,nm))*dti - &
3763 ttens(:,:,k) )
3764
3765 fvtens(:,:,1,k,ie) = fptr%base(ie)%spheremp(:,:)* &
3766 ( (1+gam)*(fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,1,k,np1) - fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,1,k,nm1))*dti - &
3767 gam*(fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,1,k,nm1) - fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,1,k,nm))*dti - &
3768 vtens1(:,:,k) )
3769
3770 fvtens(:,:,2,k,ie) = fptr%base(ie)%spheremp(:,:)* &
3771 ( (1+gam)*(fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,2,k,np1) - fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,2,k,nm1))*dti - &
3772 gam*(fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,2,k,nm1) - fptr%base(ie)%state%v(:,:,2,k,nm))*dti - &
3773 vtens2(:,:,k) )
3774 enddo
3775 fpstens(:,:,ie) = fptr%base(ie)%spheremp(:,:)* &
3776 ( (1+gam)*(fptr%base(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1) - fptr%base(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nm1))*dti - &
3777 gam*(fptr%base(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nm1) - fptr%base(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,nm))*dti + &
3778 sdot_sum(:,:) )
3779
3780! add for fdptens later for vert lagrangian
3781
3782 ! =========================================================
3783 !
3784 ! Pack ps(np1), T, and v tendencies into comm buffer
3785 !
3786 ! =========================================================
3787 kptr=0
3788 call edgeVpack(edge3p1, fpstens(:,:,ie),1,kptr,ie)
3789
3790 kptr=1
3791 call edgeVpack(edge3p1, fttens(:,:,:,ie),nlev,kptr,ie)
3792
3793 kptr=nlev+1
3794 call edgeVpack(edge3p1, fvtens(:,:,:,:,ie),2*nlev,kptr,ie)
3795
3796 if (rsplit>0) then
3797 kptr=kptr+2*nlev
3798 call edgeVpack(edge3p1, fdptens(:,:,:,ie),nlev,kptr,ie)
3799 endif
3800 end do
3801
3802 ! =============================================================
3803 ! Insert communications here: for shared memory, just a single
3804 ! sync is required
3805 ! =============================================================
3806
3807 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3p1)
3808
3809 do ie=nets,nete
3810 ! ===========================================================
3811 ! Unpack the edges for vgrad_T and v tendencies...
3812 ! ===========================================================
3813 kptr=0
3814 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, fpstens(:,:,ie), 1, kptr, ie)
3815
3816 kptr=1
3817 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, fttens(:,:,:,ie), nlev, kptr, ie)
3818
3819 kptr=nlev+1
3820 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, fvtens(:,:,:,:,ie), 2*nlev, kptr, ie)
3821
3822 if (rsplit>0) then
3823 kptr=kptr+2*nlev
3824 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, fdptens(:,:,:,ie),nlev,kptr,ie)
3825 endif
3826
3827 ! ====================================================
3828 ! Scale tendencies by inverse mass matrix
3829 ! ====================================================
3830
3831#if (defined COLUMN_OPENMP)
3832!$omp parallel do private(k)
3833#endif
3834 do k=1,nlev
3835 fttens(:,:,k,ie) = fptr%base(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)*fttens(:,:,k,ie)
3836 fvtens(:,:,1,k,ie) = fptr%base(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)*fvtens(:,:,1,k,ie)
3837 fvtens(:,:,2,k,ie) = fptr%base(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)*fvtens(:,:,2,k,ie)
3838 end do
3839
3840 if (rsplit>0) then
3841 ! vertically lagrangian: complete dp3d timestep:
3842 do k=1,nlev
3843 fdptens(:,:,k,ie)= fptr%base(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)*fdptens(:,:,k,ie)
3844 enddo
3845 ! when debugging: also update ps_v
3846 fpstens(:,:,ie) = fptr%base(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)*fpstens(:,:,ie)
3847 else
3848 ! vertically eulerian: complete ps_v timestep:
3849 fpstens(:,:,ie) = fptr%base(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)*fpstens(:,:,ie)
3850 endif
3851
3852 end do
3853
3854 call t_stopf('residual_cal')
3855 call t_startf('residual_fin')
3856 lx = 1
3857 do ie=nets,nete
3858 do k=1,nlev
3859 do j=1,np
3860 do i=1,np
3861 fx(lx) = fvtens(i,j,1,k,ie)
3862 lx = lx+1
3863 end do
3864 end do
3865 end do
3866 end do
3867 do ie=nets,nete
3868 do k=1,nlev
3869 do j=1,np
3870 do i=1,np
3871 fx(lx) = fvtens(i,j,2,k,ie)
3872 lx = lx+1
3873 end do
3874 end do
3875 end do
3876 end do
3877 do ie=nets,nete
3878 do k=1,nlev
3879 do j=1,np
3880 do i=1,np
3881 fx(lx) = fttens(i,j,k,ie)
3882 lx = lx+1
3883 end do
3884 end do
3885 end do
3886 end do
3887 do ie=nets,nete
3888 do j=1,np
3889 do i=1,np
3890 fx(lx) = fpstens(i,j,ie)
3891 lx = lx+1
3892 end do
3893 end do
3894 end do
3895 call t_stopf('residual_fin')
3896
3897! if (hybrid%masterthread) print*, "F(u,v,t,p)",NORM2(fvtens),NORM2(fttens),NORM2(fpstens)
3898
3899 call t_stopf('residual')
3900 call t_adj_detailf(-1)
3901
3902 end subroutine residual

4003 subroutine smooth_phis(phis,elem,hybrid,deriv,nets,nete,minf,numcycle)
4004 use dimensions_mod, only : np, np, nlev
4005 use control_mod, only : smooth_phis_nudt, hypervis_scaling
4006 use hybrid_mod, only : hybrid_t
4007 use edgetype_mod, only : EdgeBuffer_t
4008 use edge_mod, only : edgevpack, edgevunpack, edgevunpackmax, edgevunpackmin
4009 use bndry_mod, only : bndry_exchangev
4010 use element_mod, only : element_t
4011 use derivative_mod, only : derivative_t , laplace_sphere_wk
4012 use time_mod, only : TimeLevel_t
4013 implicit none
4014
4015 integer :: nets,nete
4016 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nets:nete), intent(inout) :: phis
4017 type (hybrid_t) , intent(in) :: hybrid
4018 type (element_t) , intent(inout), target :: elem(:)
4019 type (derivative_t) , intent(in) :: deriv
4020 real (kind=real_kind), intent(in) :: minf
4021 integer, intent(in) :: numcycle
4022
4023 ! local
4024 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(np,np,nets:nete) :: pstens
4025 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(nets:nete) :: pmin,pmax
4026 real (kind=real_kind) :: mx,mn
4027 integer :: nt,ie,ic,i,j,order,order_max, iuse
4028 logical :: use_var_coef
4029
4030
4031 ! compute local element neighbor min/max
4032 do ie=nets,nete
4033 pstens(:,:,ie)=minval(phis(:,:,ie))
4034 call edgeVpack(edge3p1,pstens(:,:,ie),1,0,ie)
4035 enddo
4036 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3p1)
4037 do ie=nets,nete
4038 call edgeVunpackMin(edge3p1, pstens(:,:,ie), 1, 0, ie)
4039 pmin(ie)=minval(pstens(:,:,ie))
4040 enddo
4041 do ie=nets,nete
4042 pstens(:,:,ie)=maxval(phis(:,:,ie))
4043 call edgeVpack(edge3p1,pstens(:,:,ie),1,0,ie)
4044 enddo
4045 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3p1)
4046 do ie=nets,nete
4047 call edgeVunpackMax(edge3p1, pstens(:,:,ie), 1, 0, ie)
4048 pmax(ie)=maxval(pstens(:,:,ie))
4049 enddo
4050
4051 ! order = 1 grad^2 laplacian
4052 ! order = 2 grad^4 (need to add a negative sign)
4053 ! order = 3 grad^6
4054 ! order = 4 grad^8 (need to add a negative sign)
4055 order_max = 1
4056
4057
4058 use_var_coef=.true.
4059 if (hypervis_scaling/=0) then
4060 ! for tensorHV option, we turn off the tensor except for *last* laplace operator
4061 use_var_coef=.false.
4062 if (hypervis_scaling>=3) then
4063 ! with a 3.2 or 4 scaling, assume hyperviscosity
4064 order_max = 2
4065 endif
4066 endif
4067
4068
4069 do ic=1,numcycle
4070 pstens=phis
4071
4072 do order=1,order_max-1
4073
4074 do ie=nets,nete
4075 ! pstens(:,:,ie)=laplace_sphere_wk(pstens(:,:,ie),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=use_var_coef)
4076 call laplace_sphere_wk(pstens(:,:,ie),deriv,elem(ie),pstens(:,:,ie), var_coef=use_var_coef)
4077 call edgeVpack(edge3p1,pstens(:,:,ie),1,0,ie)
4078 enddo
4079 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3p1)
4080 do ie=nets,nete
4081 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, pstens(:,:,ie), 1, 0, ie)
4082 pstens(:,:,ie)=pstens(:,:,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
4083 enddo
4084 enddo
4085 do ie=nets,nete
4086 ! pstens(:,:,ie)=laplace_sphere_wk(pstens(:,:,ie),deriv,elem(ie),var_coef=.true.)
4087 call laplace_sphere_wk(pstens(:,:,ie),deriv,elem(ie),pstens(:,:,ie), var_coef=.true.)
4088 enddo
4089 if (mod(order_max,2)==0) pstens=-pstens
4090
4091 do ie=nets,nete
4092 ! ps(t+1) = ps(t) + Minv * DSS * M * RHS
4093 ! ps(t+1) = Minv * DSS * M [ ps(t) + RHS ]
4094 ! but output of biharminc_wk is of the form M*RHS. rewrite as:
4095 ! ps(t+1) = Minv * DSS * M [ ps(t) + M*RHS/M ]
4096 ! so we can apply limiter to ps(t) + (M*RHS)/M
4097#if 1
4098 mn=pmin(ie)
4099 mx=pmax(ie)
4100 iuse = numcycle+1 ! always apply min/max limiter
4101#endif
4102 phis(:,:,ie)=phis(:,:,ie) + &
4103 smooth_phis_nudt*pstens(:,:,ie)/elem(ie)%spheremp(:,:)
4104
4105
4106 ! remove new extrema. could use conservative reconstruction from advection
4107 ! but no reason to conserve mean PHI.
4108 if (ic < iuse) then
4109 do i=1,np
4110 do j=1,np
4111 if (phis(i,j,ie)>mx) phis(i,j,ie)=mx
4112 if (phis(i,j,ie)<mn) phis(i,j,ie)=mn
4113 enddo
4114 enddo
4115 endif
4116
4117
4118 ! user specified minimum
4119 do i=1,np
4120 do j=1,np
4121 if (phis(i,j,ie)<minf) phis(i,j,ie)=minf
4122 enddo
4123 enddo
4124
4125 phis(:,:,ie)=phis(:,:,ie)*elem(ie)%spheremp(:,:)
4126 call edgeVpack(edge3p1,phis(:,:,ie),1,0,ie)
4127 enddo
4128 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3p1)
4129 do ie=nets,nete
4130 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, phis(:,:,ie), 1, 0, ie)
4131 phis(:,:,ie)=phis(:,:,ie)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
4132 enddo
4133 enddo
4134 end subroutine smooth_phis
4135
4136 subroutine overwrite_SEdensity(elem, fvm, dt_q, hybrid,nets,nete, np1)
4137 use fvm_reconstruction_mod, only: reconstruction
4138 use fvm_filter_mod, only: monotonic_gradient_cart, recons_val_cart
4139 use dimensions_mod, only : np, nlev, nc,nhe
4140 use hybrid_mod, only : hybrid_t
4141 use edgetype_mod, only : EdgeBuffer_t
4142 use edge_mod, only : edgevpack, edgevunpack, edgevunpackmax, edgevunpackmin
4143 use bndry_mod, only : bndry_exchangev
4144 use element_mod, only : element_t
4145 use derivative_mod, only : derivative_t , laplace_sphere_wk
4146 use time_mod, only : TimeLevel_t
4147 use fvm_control_volume_mod, only : fvm_struct
4148 use spelt_mod, only : spelt_struct
4149
4150
4151 type (element_t) , intent(inout) :: elem(:)
4152
4153#if defined(_SPELT)
4154 type(spelt_struct), intent(inout) :: fvm(:)
4155#else
4156 type(fvm_struct), intent(inout) :: fvm(:)
4157#endif
4158 type (hybrid_t), intent(in) :: hybrid ! distributed parallel structure (shared)
4159
4160 integer, intent(in) :: nets ! starting thread element number (private)
4161 integer, intent(in) :: nete ! ending thread element number (private)
4162 integer, intent(in) :: np1
4163 integer :: ie, k
4164
4165 real (kind=real_kind) :: xp,yp, tmpval, dt_q
4166 integer :: i, j,ix, jy, starti,endi,tmpi
4167
4168 real (kind=real_kind), dimension(5,1-nhe:nc+nhe,1-nhe:nc+nhe) :: recons
4169
4170 if ((nc .ne. 4) .or. (np .ne. 4)) then
4171 if(hybrid%masterthread) then
4172 print *,"You are in OVERWRITE SE AIR DENSITY MODE"
4173 print *,"This only works for nc=4 and np=4"
4174 print *,"Write a new search algorithm or pay $10000!"
4175 endif
4176 stop
4177 endif
4178#if defined(_FVM)
4179 do ie=nets,nete
4180 call reconstruction(fvm(ie)%psc, fvm(ie),recons)
4181 call monotonic_gradient_cart(fvm(ie)%psc, fvm(ie),recons, elem(ie)%desc)
4182 do j=1,np
4183 do i=1,np
4184 xp=tan(elem(ie)%cartp(i,j)%x)
4185 yp=tan(elem(ie)%cartp(i,j)%y)
4186 ix=i
4187 jy=j
4188 ! Search index along "x" (bisection method)
4189! starti = 1
4190! endi = nc+1
4191! do
4192! if ((endi-starti) <= 1) exit
4193! tmpi = (endi + starti)/2
4194! if (xp > fvm%acartx(tmpi)) then
4195! starti = tmpi
4196! else
4197! endi = tmpi
4198! endif
4199! enddo
4200! ix = starti
4201!
4202! ! Search index along "y"
4203! starti = 1
4204! endi = nc+1
4205! do
4206! if ((endi-starti) <= 1) exit
4207! tmpi = (endi + starti)/2
4208! if (yp > fvm%acarty(tmpi)) then
4209! starti = tmpi
4210! else
4211! endi = tmpi
4212! endif
4213! enddo
4214! jy = starti
4215
4216 call recons_val_cart(fvm(ie)%psc, xp,yp,fvm(ie)%spherecentroid,recons,ix,jy,tmpval)
4217 elem(ie)%state%ps_v(i,j,np1)= elem(ie)%state%ps_v(i,j,np1) +&
4218 dt_q*(tmpval - elem(ie)%state%ps_v(i,j,np1) )/(7*24*60*60)
4219 end do
4220 end do
4221 elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1)=elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1)*elem(ie)%spheremp(:,:)
4222 call edgeVpack(edge3p1,elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1),1,0,ie)
4223 enddo
4224 call bndry_exchangeV(hybrid,edge3p1)
4225 do ie=nets,nete
4226 call edgeVunpack(edge3p1, elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1), 1, 0, ie)
4227 elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1)=elem(ie)%state%ps_v(:,:,np1)*elem(ie)%rspheremp(:,:)
4228 enddo
4229#endif
4230 end subroutine overwrite_SEdensity
